" alt="Jado Kuin Do"><span class="brand-v37-copy"><strong>WORLD JADO KUIN DO</strong><span>ORGANISATION</span></span></a>`};

20Z"/></svg><span>X / TWITTER</span></a><a class="social-link" href="https://www.facebook.com/WjONicolaOgden/" target="_blank" rel="noopener" aria-label="WJO on Facebook"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" 2.1c1.9.5 9.4.5 9.4.5s7.5 0 9.4-.5a3 3 0 0 0 2.1-2.1A31.2 31.2 0 0 0 24 12a31.2 31.2 0 0 0-.5-5.8ZM9.6 15.6V8.4l6.2 3.6-6.2 3.6Z"/></svg><span>YOUTUBE</span></a></div><button shell=function(body){return header()+body+footer()+mobileMenu()+`<button class="mobile-menu-fab" type="button" onclick="openMenu()" aria-label="Open menu"><span class="bars"><i></i><i></i><i></i></span><small>MENU</small></button>`};

getProduct=function(id){return REAL_CATALOGUE.find(p=>p.id===id)||REAL_CATALOGUE[0]};
function v3ImgError(img){if(img.dataset.alt&&!img.dataset.tried){img.dataset.tried='1';img.src=img.dataset.alt;return}const box=img.parentElement;if(box)box.innerHTML='<div class="image-unavailable"><b>Official product photo unavailable</b><br>This item is still listed in the shop.</div>'}
window.v3ImgError=v3ImgError;
function v3ProductImage(p){return `<img src="${p.image}" data-alt="${p.alt||''}" onerror="v3ImgError(this)" alt="${p.name}">`}
function v3ProductCard(p){return `<div class="real-product-card"><div class="real-product-image">${v3ProductImage(p)}</div><div class="real-product-copy"><span class="tag">${p.category}</span><h3>${p.name}</h3><p>${p.desc}</p><div class="price">${money(p.price)}</div><div class="real-product-actions"><a class="btn ghost" href="#product?id=${p.id}">DETAILS</a><button class="btn red" onclick="addToCart('${p.id}',1,'${(p.sizes&&p.sizes[0])||'Standard'}')">ADD</button></div></div></div>`}

// Clean home wording and include the real WJO testimonial videos already embedded on the live site.
const V3_HOME_BASE=routes.home;
routes.home=function(){let html=V3_HOME_BASE();html=html.replace('The new WJO look','World Jado Organisation');const grades=`<section class="grade-home-v55"><div class="wrap"><div class="v47-section-heading"><div><div class="v47-eyebrow">Your progression</div><h2>See the full WJO<br>grading journey.</h2></div><p>White through to Black, including Purple and the two Brown belts with their centre stripes.</p></div><div class="grade-mini-row">${[['white','White'],['yellow','Yellow'],['orange','Orange'],['red','Red'],['green','Green'],['blue','Blue'],['purple','Purple'],['brown-red','Brown / red stripe'],['brown-black','Brown / black stripe'],['black','Black']].map(x=>`<a class="grade-mini-v55 ${x[0]}" href="#grade-order"><i></i><span>${x[1]}</span></a>`).join('')}</div><div style="margin-top:28px"><a class="v47-primary" href="#grade-order">VIEW GRADE ORDER <span>↗</span></a></div></div></section>`;const videos=`<section class="section alt"><div class="wrap"><div class="section-header"><div><div class="kicker">WJO stories</div><h2>Hear from students and families.</h2></div><p>Real stories from the WJO community.</p></div><div class="video-grid"><div class="video-card"><a class="video-thumb" href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=k0PL3aq-eSo" target="_blank" rel="noopener" style="--videobg:url('assets/hero-black-gi-child.jpg')"><div class="video-topbar"><span class="video-platform">Watch on YouTube ↗</span></div><div class="video-play"><span class="play-icon"></span><span>Open Billy’s Story</span></div></a><div class="video-copy"><h3>Billy’s Story</h3><p>A student story from WJO.</p></div></div><div class="video-card"><a class="video-thumb" href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=RlAgOido-MY" target="_blank" class="play-icon"></span><span>Open A Parent’s View</span></div></a><div class="video-copy"><h3>A Parent’s View</h3><p>A parent shares their experience of the organisation.</p></div></div><div class="video-card"><a class="video-thumb" href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=1w0wcMe-fRI" target="_blank" rel="noopener" style="--videobg:url('assets/venue-community-daventry.jpg')"><div routes.about=()=>shell(`<main>${pageHero('SETTING THE STANDARD <em>FOR JADO.</em>','About WJO','The World Jado Organisation governs Jado systems and promotes professional standards across its schools, clubs and instructors.')}<section class="page-section"><div class="wrap grid-2"><div><div class="kicker">Our purpose</div><h2 style="font-size:54px;line-height:1">Inspiring healthier communities through life skills.</h2><p style="color:#b6bbc4">The WJO was formed in 2003 to govern Jado activity and maintain consistent standards, codes of conduct and professional delivery.</p></div><div class="content-card"><h3>Professional standards</h3><p>Academies, clubs and institutes delivering Jado systems operate within the standards set by the organisation.</p><div class="helper-list"><div><strong>Integrity</strong> Professional conduct and responsibility.</div><div><strong>Development</strong> Continual learning for students and instructors.</div></div></div></div></section><section class="page-section cream"><div class="wrap"><div class="section-header"><div><div class="kicker">Our values</div><h2>How WJO shows up.</h2></div></div><div class="value-grid"><div class="value-card" style="--valuebg:url('assets/value-integrity-v2.png')"><span class="num">01</span><h3>Integrity</h3><strong>Do the right thing.</strong><p>Lead with honesty, fairness and responsibility in and out of the training hall.</p></div><div class="value-card" style="--valuebg:url('assets/value-humility-v2.png')"><span class="num">02</span><h3>Humility</h3><strong>Keep learning.</strong><p>Stay respectful, coachable and open to growth at every stage.</p></div><div class="value-card" style="--valuebg:url('assets/value-discipline-v2.png')"><span class="num">03</span><h3>Discipline</h3><strong>Build consistent habits.</strong><p>Progress comes from focus, repetition and showing up with intent.</p></div><div class="value-card" style="--valuebg:url('assets/value-improvement-v2.png')"><span class="num">04</span><h3>Improvement</h3><strong>Move forward continually.</strong><p>Small gains build lasting confidence, skill and character.</p></div></div></div></section><section class="page-section"><div class="wrap grid-3"><a class="content-card" href="#jado"><h3>What is Jado Kuin Do?</h3><p>The art, its history and its principles.</p></a><a class="content-card" href="#leadership"><h3>Leadership</h3><p>Meet the WJO committee and grading team.</p></a><a class="content-card" href="#safeguarding"><h3>Safeguarding</h3><p>Policies, safe practice and parent information.</p></a></div></section></main>`);

// Replace the Super J's wing graphic with an actual crane image and label it simply Crane.
const V3_SUPER_BASE=routes['super-js'];
routes['super-js']=function(){let html=V3_SUPER_BASE();html=html.replace(/<div class="emoji wing-icon">[\s\S]*?<\/div><strong>CRANE WING<\/strong>/,`<div class="crane-photo"><img src="${V3_CRANE}" alt="Crane"></div><strong>CRANE</strong>`);return html};

const V3_COMMITTEE_IMAGES={
 founder:'assets/instructor-master-ogden.png',
 nicola:'assets/instructor-nicola.png',
 neal:'assets/instructor-neal-worth.png',
 hazel:'assets/instructor-hazel.png',
 jakes:'assets/instructor-jake-springthorpe.png',
 kevin:'assets/instructor-kevin.png'
};

routes.founder=()=>shell(`<main>${pageHero('GRAND MASTER <em>JAKE OGDEN.</em>','Founder & President','Founder of the World Jado Organisation, creator of Jado Kuin Do and 9th Degree Black Belt.')}<section class="page-section"><div class="wrap founder-real"><div class="founder-photo"><img src="${V3_COMMITTEE_IMAGES.founder}" alt="Grand Master Jake Ogden"></div><div class="founder-copy"><div class="kicker">Founder • President • 9th Degree Black Belt</div><h2>Honouring tradition. Inspiring excellence.</h2><p style="color:#b8bec8">Grand Master Jake Ogden has spent more than four decades studying, developing and promoting martial arts, combining elite sport, higher education and professional protective-security experience.</p><div class="quote">“Every student who joins the World Jado Organisation deserves excellent instruction, professional standards and an environment that inspires them.”</div><div class="profile-facts"><div><span>•</span>Creator of Jado Kuin Do</div><div><span>•</span>Three-time British Kickboxing Champion</div><div><span>•</span>British Kung Fu Champion</div><div><span>•</span>World Karate Champion and World Open Martial Arts Champion</div></div></div></div></section><section class="page-section cream"><div class="wrap article-copy"><div class="kicker">Background</div><p>Jake began training at eight in Traditional Kung Fu and Judo. He later competed at national and world level, trained internationally in Japan, Hong Kong and China, and combined martial arts with academic study in security management, law, sports management, education and counter-terrorism risk management.</p><p>His professional career has included protective security, intelligence and security management work supporting senior officials, elite athletes and major international sporting events.</p><p>Jado Kuin Do grew from a private training group into the World Jado Organisation, with a focus on practical personal protection, modern coaching, confidence, resilience, humility, discipline and character.</p></div></section></main>`);

leaderProfile=function(name,role,searches,facts,paragraphs){const key=name.includes('Nicola')?'nicola':name.includes('Neal')?'neal':name.includes('Hazel')?'hazel':name.includes('Springthorpe')?'jakes':name.includes('Kevin')?'kevin':'founder';const img=V3_COMMITTEE_IMAGES[key]||V3_COMMITTEE_IMAGES.founder;return shell(`<main>${pageHero(name.toUpperCase(),role,paragraphs[0])}<section class="page-section"><div class="wrap founder-real"><div class="founder-photo"><img src="${img}" alt="${name}"></div><div class="founder-copy"><div class="kicker">${role}</div><h2>${facts[0]}</h2><div class="profile-facts">${facts.slice(1).map(f=>`<div><span>•</span>${f}</div>`).join('')}</div></div></div></section><section class="page-section cream"><div class="wrap article-copy">${paragraphs.slice(1).map(p=>`<p>${p}</p>`).join('')}</div></section></main>`)};

the organisation.')}<section class="page-section"><div class="wrap"><div class="leader-grid-v3"><a class="leader-card-v3 leader-card" href="#founder"><img src="${V3_COMMITTEE_IMAGES.founder}" alt="Grand Master Jake Ogden"><div class="leader-copy"><div class="kicker">Founder & President</div><h3>Grand Master Jake Ogden</h3><p>Creator of Jado Kuin Do • 9th Degree Black Belt</p></div></a><a Nicola Ogden</h3><p>Designated Safeguarding Lead • 1st Degree Black Belt</p></div></a><a class="leader-card-v3 leader-card" href="#leader-neal"><img src="${V3_COMMITTEE_IMAGES.neal}" alt="Neal Worth"><div class="leader-copy"><div class="kicker">Executive Committee</div><h3>Sifu Neal Worth</h3><p>Jado Guardian • Grading Examiner • 5th Degree</p></div></a><a class="leader-card-v3 leader-card" href="#leader-hazel"><img src="${V3_COMMITTEE_IMAGES.hazel}" alt="Hazel Williams"><div class="leader-copy"><div class="kicker">Executive Committee</div><h3>Sifu Hazel Williams</h3><p>Jado Guardian • Lead Grading Examiner • 5th Degree</p></div></a><a class="leader-card-v3 leader-card" href="#leader-jake-s"><img src="${V3_COMMITTEE_IMAGES.jakes}" alt="Jake Springthorpe"><div class="leader-copy"><div class="kicker">Grading Committee</div><h3>Sifu Jake Springthorpe BSc</h3><p>Senior Instructor • 4th Degree Black Belt</p></div></a><a class="leader-card-v3 leader-card" href="#leader-kevin"><img src="${V3_COMMITTEE_IMAGES.kevin}" alt="Kevin Rattigan"><div class="leader-copy"><div class="kicker">Grading Examination Team</div><h3>Sifu Kevin Rattigan</h3><p>Senior function shopFilter(category){const target='#shop?category='+encodeURIComponent(category)+'&scroll=products';if(location.hash===target){render();setTimeout(()=>document.getElementById('shop-products')?.scrollIntoView({behavior:'smooth',block:'start'}),80)}else{location.hash=target}}
window.shopFilter=shopFilter;

routes.shop=()=>{const selected=hashParams().get('category')||'All';const categories=['Uniforms','Sparring','Clothing','Training','Membership','Gifts','Books','All'];const products=selected==='All'?REAL_CATALOGUE:REAL_CATALOGUE.filter(p=>p.category===selected);const descriptions={Uniforms:'Official training uniforms',Sparring:'Approved protective equipment',Clothing:'WJO apparel and casual wear',Training:'Equipment for practice',Membership:'Individual and family membership',Gifts:'Certificates and gift ideas',Books:'Books and personalised items',All:'Browse the complete range'};return shell(`<main><section class="page-section"><div class="wrap"><div class="shop-hero"><div class="shop-hero-copy"><div class="kicker" style="color:#ffdadd">Official WJO shop</div><h1>TRAIN JADO.<br>WEAR JADO.</h1><p>Uniforms, WJO-approved sparring equipment, clothing, training gear, memberships and gifts in one shop.</p><div class="hero-actions"><a class="btn light" href="#shop?category=Membership&scroll=products" onclick="shopFilter('Membership');return false">MEMBERSHIPS</a><a class="btn ghost" href="#cart">BASKET (${cartCount()})</a></div></div><div class="shop-hero-art">${v3ProductImage(getProduct('gia'))}</div></div></div></section><section class="page-section"><div class="wrap"><div class="section-header"><div><div class="kicker">Shop by category</div><h2>Find exactly what you need.</h2></div><p>Choose a category and jump straight to the matching products.</p></div><div class="shop-categories-v6">${categories.map((c,i)=>{const count=c==='All'?REAL_CATALOGUE.length:REAL_CATALOGUE.filter(p=>p.category===c).length;return `<a class="shop-cat-v6 ${selected===c?'active':''}" href="#shop?category=${encodeURIComponent(c)}&scroll=products" onclick="shopFilter('${c}');return false"><img class="shop-cat-photo" src="${categoryImage(c)}" alt="${c}"><div class="shop-cat-top"><span class="shop-cat-index">${String(i+1).padStart(2,'0')}</span><span class="shop-cat-arrow">↘</span></div><div><h3>${c==='All'?'All products':c}</h3><p>${descriptions[c]} · ${count} ${count===1?'item':'items'}</p></div></a>`}).join('')}</div></div></section><section id="shop-products" class="page-section alt shop-products-anchor"><div class="wrap"><div class="section-header"><div><div class="kicker">${selected==='All'?'Shop all':selected}</div><h2>${selected==='All'?'Official Jado products.':selected}</h2></div><a class="btn ghost" href="#cart">VIEW BASKET</a></div>${products.length?`<div class="product-grid-v3">${products.map(v3ProductCard).join('')}</div>`:`<div class="empty-shop"><h3>No products are currently listed here.</h3><p>The existing Jado Online Books / Personalised category is currently empty.</p><a class="btn ghost" href="#shop?category=All&scroll=products" onclick="shopFilter('All');return false">VIEW ALL PRODUCTS</a></div>`}</div></section></main>`)};

routes.product=()=>{const p=getProduct(hashParams().get('id')||'gia');const isMembership=p.category==='Membership';return shell(`<main>${pageHero(p.name.toUpperCase(),'Shop / '+p.category,p.desc)}<section class="page-section"><div class="wrap product-real-layout"><div><div class="product-real-image">${v3ProductImage(p)}</div><div class="product-source">Official Jado Online product listing: ${p.code}</div></div><div class="product-info"><div class="kicker">WJO ${p.category}</div><h1>${p.name}</h1><div class="price-big">${money(p.price)} <small style="font-size:13px;color:#aeb3bc">Inc VAT where applicable</small></div><p style="color:#aeb3bc">${p.desc}</p>${isMembership?`<div class="membership-fields"><input id="member-name" class="field" placeholder="Student / family name"><select id="member-club" class="field"><option>Select club</option><option>Brackley</option><option>Banbury</option><option>Bicester</option><option>Corby</option><option>Daventry</option><option>Flore</option><option>Rugby</option><option>Towcester</option><option>Other</option></select><label style="display:flex;gap:10px;align-items:flex-start;color:#b9c0ca"><input type="checkbox"> I agree to the WJO membership agreement</label></div>`:''}<div class="choice-grid"><div class="choice"><label>Option</label><select id="product-size" class="field" style="width:100%">${(p.sizes||['Standard']).map(s=>`<option>${s}</option>`).join('')}</select></div><div class="choice"><label>Quantity</label><input id="product-qty" class="field" type="number" min="1" value="1" style="width:100%"></div></div><button class="btn red" style="width:100%;height:54px" onclick="addToCart('${p.id}',Number(document.getElementById('product-qty').value||1),document.getElementById('product-size').value)">ADD TO BASKET</button><a class="btn ghost" href="${p.source}" target="_blank" rel="noopener" style="width:100%;margin-top:10px">VIEW ORIGINAL JADO ONLINE LISTING ↗</a></div></div></section></main>`)};

routes.cart=()=>{const items=getCart();const rows=items.map(item=>{const p=getProduct(item.id);return `<div class="cart-row"><div class="cart-thumb" style="background:#f2f2ef;padding:5px">${v3ProductImage(p)}</div><div><h3>${p.name}</h3><span style="color:#aeb3bc">${item.size}</span></div><div>Qty ${item.qty}</div><b>${money(p.price*item.qty)}</b><button class="btn ghost" onclick="removeFromCart('${item.id}','${item.size}')">REMOVE</button></div>`}).join('');const subtotal=items.reduce((s,i)=>s+getProduct(i.id).price*i.qty,0);return shell(`<main>${pageHero('YOUR <em>BASKET.</em>','Shop','Review your WJO products and memberships before checkout.')}<section class="page-section"><div class="wrap checkout-grid"><div class="cart-table">${items.length?rows:`<div class="empty-shop"><h3>Your basket is empty.</h3><a class="btn red" href="#shop">SHOP PRODUCTS</a></div>`}</div><div class="summary"><h3>Order summary</h3><div class="summary-row"><span>Items</span><b>${cartCount()}</b></div><div class="summary-row"><span>Subtotal</span><b>${money(subtotal)}</b></div><div class="summary-row"><span>Delivery</span><b>Calculated next</b></div><div class="summary-row"><span>Total</span><b>${money(subtotal)}</b></div><a class="btn dark" href="#checkout" style="width:100%;margin-top:18px">CHECKOUT</a></div></div></section></main>`)};

routes.checkout=()=>{const items=getCart();const subtotal=items.reduce((s,i)=>s+getProduct(i.id).price*i.qty,0);return shell(`<main>${pageHero('SECURE <em>CHECKOUT.</em>','Shop / Checkout','Contact, delivery and payment details in one clear checkout flow.')}<section class="page-section"><div class="wrap checkout-grid"><div><div class="content-card"><h2>Contact & delivery</h2><div class="form-grid"><input class="field" placeholder="First name"><input class="field" placeholder="Last name"><input class="field wide" placeholder="Email"><input class="field wide" placeholder="Address"><input class="field" placeholder="Town / city"><input class="field" placeholder="Postcode"><select class="field wide"><option>Standard UK delivery</option><option>Collect via instructor / club</option></select></div></div><div class="content-card" style="margin-top:14px"><h2>Payment</h2><div class="field">Card / supported WooCommerce payment gateway</div></div></div><div class="summary"><h3>Your order</h3>${items.length?items.map(i=>{const p=getProduct(i.id);return `<div class="summary-row"><span>${p.name}<small>${i.size} • Qty ${i.qty}</small></span><b>${money(p.price*i.qty)}</b></div>`}).join(''):`<div class="summary-row"><span>No products selected</span><b>£0.00</b></div>`}<div class="summary-row"><span>Total</span><b>${money(subtotal)}</b></div><button class="btn dark" style="width:100%;margin-top:18px">PLACE ORDER</button></div></div></section></main>`)};

routes.account=()=>shell(`<main>${pageHero('YOUR <em>ACCOUNT.</em>','Shop / My account','Manage orders, addresses, account details and WJO memberships.')}<section class="page-section"><div class="wrap grid-3"><a class="content-card" href="#account"><div class="icon-circle">↗</div><h3>Orders</h3><p>Track and review recent shop orders.</p></a><a class="content-card" href="#account"><div class="icon-circle">⌂</div><h3>Addresses</h3><p>Manage billing and delivery details.</p></a><a class="content-card" href="#account"><div class="icon-circle">◎</div><h3>Account details</h3><p>Name, email and password settings.</p></a><a class="content-card" href="#shop?category=Membership"><div class="icon-circle">🪪</div><h3>Memberships</h3><p>Individual and family membership options.</p></a><a class="content-card" href="#shop"><div class="icon-circle">♡</div><h3>Shop</h3><p>Browse uniforms, equipment and clothing.</p></a><a class="content-card" href="#home"><div class="icon-circle">←</div><h3>Log out</h3><p>Return to the main WJO website.</p></a></div></section></main>`);

async function loadLiveWjoPhotos(){
  const imgs=[...document.querySelectorAll('img.live-wjo-photo')];
  for(const img of imgs){
    const fallback=img.dataset.fallback||'data:image/jpeg;base64,';
    const terms=(img.dataset.wjoSearches||'').split('|').filter(Boolean);
    let loaded=false;
    for(const term of terms){
      try{
        const url=`https://wjo.org.uk/wp-json/wp/v2/media?search=${encodeURIComponent(term)}&per_page=20&_fields=source_url,mime_type,alt_text,title`;
        const res=await fetch(url,{mode:'cors'});
        if(!res.ok) continue;
        const items=await res.json();
        const media=items.find(m=>(m.mime_type||'').startsWith('image/') && m.source_url);
        if(media){img.src=media.source_url; loaded=true; break;}
      }catch(e){}
    }
    if(!loaded) img.src=fallback;
    img.addEventListener('error',()=>{if(img.src!==fallback) img.src=fallback;},{once:true});
  }
}

function instructorCard(i){const src=i.photo||i.fallback;const isFallback=!i.photo;const photo=`<img class="${isFallback?'fallback-animal':''}" src="${src}" data-fallback="${i.fallback}" alt="${i.name}" onerror="if(this.dataset.fallback&&this.src.indexOf(this.dataset.fallback)===-1){this.src=this.dataset.fallback;this.classList.add('fallback-animal')}">`;return `<article class="instructor-card"><div class="instructor-photo">${photo}<span class="photo-label">${isFallback?'Profile artwork':'WJO instructor'}</span></div><div class="instructor-copy"><div class="role">${i.role}</div><h3>${i.name}</h3><p>${i.summary}</p><div class="location-chips">${i.locations.map(l=>`<a href="#find-school?q=${encodeURIComponent(l)}">${l}</a>`).join('')}</div></div></article>`}

routes['safe-practice']=()=>shell(`<main>${pageHero('SAFE PRACTICE <em>FIRST.</em>','Safeguarding / Safe Practice','WJO guidance for safer martial arts training, including contact, protective equipment, supervision, training areas and instructor responsibilities.')}<section class="page-section"><div class="wrap"><div class="safeguard-alert"><div class="alert-mark">!</div><div><b>Safety comes before the drill.</b><p>Training should always be age-appropriate, supervised and subject to ongoing risk assessment.</p></div><a class="btn ghost" href="#safeguarding">SAFEGUARDING HUB</a></div><div class="policy-meta"><span class="pill">REVIEWED 19/02/2025</span><span class="pill">WJO SAFE PRACTICE</span></div><div class="policy-page"><div class="policy-body"><section class="policy-section" id="sp-warmups"><h2>1. Warm-ups and preparation</h2><p>Every session should begin with a thorough warm-up suited to the activity that follows. The guidance places particular emphasis on preparing the muscle groups that will be used later in training.</p><h3>Throwing, grappling and strangling</h3><p>These are not part of the current WJO syllabus, but the source policy retains them as reference material. Where such activities exist elsewhere, suitable matting, a clear training area and experienced supervision are essential.</p></section><section class="policy-section" id="sp-contact"><h2>2. Strikes, punches and kicks</h2><p>WJO's guidance is deliberately cautious around head contact, particularly for students under 16. Free sparring is reserved for competent students of at least white-belt grade, at the instructor's discretion.</p><ul><li>No face striking and no kicking to the head.</li><li>Partner work should involve no or minimal head contact.</li><li>When sparring, approved head protection and a properly fitted mouth guard are required.</li><li>Any permitted head contact should be light, controlled and without follow-through.</li><li>Any suspected head injury requires assessment and first aid, with emergency services available where needed.</li></ul></section><section class="policy-section" id="sp-equipment"><h2>3. Protective equipment</h2><p>Full sparring requires the WJO-approved protective set: head guard, boxing gloves or sparring mitts, groin protection, shin protection, foot protection and a suitable mouth guard. Hands-only sparring still requires head guard, gloves or mitts and mouth protection.</p><ul><li>Equipment should be correctly fitted and checked for damage.</li><li>Sparring protection should be cleaned regularly with attention to hygiene.</li><li>Injured students should not spar and should be given a suitable non-contact alternative.</li></ul></section><section class="policy-section" id="sp-supervision"><h2>4. Matching and supervision</h2><p>Height, weight, age, grade and the physical and mental state of participants should be considered when pairing students. The source guidance sets supervision limits for sparring and requires first-aid cover.</p><ul><li>For younger practitioners, the instructor-to-practitioner ratio should not exceed one accredited instructor to five pairs, with an assistant.</li><li>For colt and adult sparring, the stated maximum is one accredited instructor to twelve pairs, plus a supervisor.</li><li>At least one certified instructor or assistant with a current First Aid certificate should be present at every sparring session.</li></ul></section><section class="policy-section" id="sp-area"><h2>5. The sparring area</h2><p>The training area should be flat, even, dry, non-slip and clear of bags, drinks, chairs or other obstructions. The main instructor must remain present, and excessive contact is prohibited.</p><p>WJO's guidance recommends approximately three square metres per pair for free sparring, while guided drills may need less depending on the exercise. The instructor's ongoing dynamic risk assessment is the final test of whether sparring can safely continue.</p></section><section class="policy-section" id="sp-weapons"><h2>6. Weapons training</h2><p>Weapons are restricted to the advanced adult syllabus and only from 3rd Degree Black Belt, at the instructor's discretion. Junior classes do not include weapons.</p><ul><li>No live or sharp blades in the training hall.</li><li>Student suitability must be assessed first.</li><li>Weapons safety, adequate space and competent supervision are required.</li><li>Dynamic risk assessment continues throughout the activity.</li></ul></section><section class="policy-section" id="sp-responsibility"><h2>7. Instructor responsibility</h2><p>The policy's central principle is that safe practice depends on a suitably qualified and experienced instructor who continuously assesses risk, protects children and adults at risk, and balances enjoyable training with the discipline required to learn safely.</p><div class="safeguard-contact"><div><div class="kicker">WJO safeguarding</div><h3>Mrs Nicola Ogden</h3><p><a href="mailto:nicola.ogden@wjo.org.uk">nicola.ogden@wjo.org.uk</a><br><a href="tel:+441327342611">01327 342611</a></p></div><div><div class="kicker">Source</div><h3>Current WJO page</h3><p>Open the live source policy for the complete current wording.</p><a class="btn ghost source-button" href="https://wjo.org.uk/safeguarding-in-martial-arts-safe-practice/" target="_blank" rel="noopener">VIEW SOURCE ↗</a></div></div></section></div><aside class="policy-sidebar"><div class="sidebar-card"><div class="kicker">On this page</div><a class="policy-jump" href="#sp-warmups">Warm-ups</a><a class="policy-jump" href="#sp-contact">Contact rules</a><a class="policy-jump" href="#sp-equipment">Protection</a><a class="policy-jump" href="#sp-supervision">Supervision</a><a class="policy-jump" href="#sp-area">Sparring area</a><a class="policy-jump" href="#sp-weapons">Weapons</a><a class="policy-jump" href="#sp-responsibility">Responsibility</a></div></aside></div></div></section></main>`)

routes['safeguarding-children']=()=>shell(`<main>${pageHero('SAFEGUARDING <em>CHILDREN.</em>','Safeguarding / Children','WJO’s policy for protecting children and young people under 18, responding to concerns and maintaining safe, child-centred martial arts environments.')}<section class="page-section"><div class="wrap"><div class="safeguard-alert"><div class="alert-mark">!</div><div><b>If a child is in immediate danger or needs urgent medical help</b><p>Call 999. The WJO policy also signposts the NSPCC helpline on 0808 800 5000.</p></div><a class="btn red" href="tel:999">CALL 999</a></div><div class="policy-meta"><span class="pill">REVIEWED 07/05/2026</span><span class="pill">CHILDREN & YOUNG PEOPLE</span></div><div class="policy-page"><div class="policy-body"><section class="policy-section" id="ch-commitment"><h2>1. Commitment and principles</h2><p>WJO states that children and young people under 18 must be safeguarded and that everyone working in its schools and clubs shares that responsibility. Welfare concerns are taken seriously and children should be encouraged to speak about anything that worries them.</p><ul><li>Provide a positive, enjoyable and child-centred experience.</li><li>Prioritise safety and wellbeing.</li><li>Make sure staff and volunteers understand how to recognise, respond to and record concerns.</li><li>Maintain detailed, confidential safeguarding records.</li><li>Use robust procedures and safer recruitment to prevent unsuitable people working with children.</li></ul></section><section class="policy-section" id="ch-law"><h2>2. Legal and statutory framework</h2><p>The current source policy references the Human Rights Act 1998, Children Acts 1989 and 2004, Working Together to Safeguard Children 2023, Keeping Children Safe in Education 2025, the Sexual Offences Act 2003 and the Data Protection Act 2018.</p><p>For safeguarding purposes, a child is generally a person under 18. The policy notes some differences within Scottish child-protection processes.</p></section><section class="policy-section" id="ch-abuse"><h2>3. Abuse, neglect and poor practice</h2><p>The policy explains that safeguarding issues can overlap and may occur within families, institutions, communities or online. Its core categories include physical abuse, emotional abuse, sexual abuse and neglect, alongside related harms such as bullying, exploitation, trafficking, forced marriage and radicalisation.</p><p>Poor practice also matters. Repeated or serious breaches of professional standards can become safeguarding concerns and should not be ignored.</p></section><section class="policy-section" id="ch-signs"><h2>4. Recognising possible concerns</h2><p>No single sign proves abuse, but staff and volunteers should remain alert to changes or patterns that may require action.</p><ul><li>Unexplained injuries or explanations that do not fit the injury.</li><li>Sudden withdrawal, distress, temper changes or unusual distrust of adults.</li><li>Changes in eating, appearance, hygiene or social behaviour.</li><li>A child describing an abusive act or another person raising concern.</li><li>Inappropriate sexual awareness or sexually explicit behaviour.</li></ul><p>The policy is clear that WJO does not decide whether abuse has occurred; its responsibility is to act on concerns and report them appropriately.</p></section><section class="policy-section" id="ch-report"><h2>5. What to do if you have a concern</h2><p>Concerns and poor practice should normally be reported to the Designated Safeguarding Lead or Deputy. Allegations involving an instructor or volunteer may require referral to the Local Authority Designated Officer.</p><h3>When a child tells you something</h3><ul><li>Stay calm and listen carefully.</li><li>Do not promise secrecy; explain that information may need to be shared to keep them safe.</li><li>Let the child speak at their own pace and only ask questions needed for clarification.</li><li>Avoid leading questions.</li><li>Reassure them that telling someone was the right thing to do.</li><li>Explain what will happen next and contact the safeguarding lead.</li><li>Refer serious concerns to statutory agencies.</li></ul></section><section class="policy-section" id="ch-record"><h2>6. Recording and information handling</h2><p>A disclosure or safeguarding incident should be written down as soon as possible, using the child's own words as closely as possible. Records should distinguish facts and observations from allegations or opinions, include relevant times and names, and be stored securely.</p><p>Accurate records should be maintained throughout any safeguarding case and shared only with those who need the information.</p></section><section class="policy-section" id="ch-workforce"><h2>7. Safer recruitment, training and an open culture</h2><p>WJO says reasonable steps should be taken to prevent unsuitable people working with children. Staff and volunteers should receive induction, supervised development, ongoing support and safeguarding training appropriate to their role.</p><p>The policy also supports whistleblowing and a complaints process so children, parents, carers, volunteers and staff can raise concerns about wrongdoing or poor practice.</p></section><section class="policy-section" id="ch-contacts"><h2>8. Useful contacts</h2><div class="contact-list"><div class="contact-item"><b>WJO Safeguarding Officer</b><span>Nicola Ogden</span><span>nicola.ogden@wjo.org.uk</span><span>01327 342611</span></div><div class="contact-item"><b>NSPCC</b><span>0808 800 5000</span><span>help@nspcc.org.uk</span></div></div><h3>Local safeguarding contacts listed by WJO</h3><details><summary>Northamptonshire / Daventry</summary><div>Multi-Agency Safeguarding Hub: 0300 126 1000. Out of hours: 01604 626938.</div></details><details><summary>Buckinghamshire</summary><div>First Response Team: 01296 383 962.</div></details><details><summary>Hertfordshire</summary><div>Concerns about children: 0300 123 4043.</div></details><details><summary>Leicestershire</summary><div>First Response Team: 0116 305 0005.</div></details><details><summary>Oxfordshire</summary><div>MASH: 0345 050 7666.</div></details><details><summary>Warwickshire</summary><div>Child safeguarding concerns: 01926 414144. Emergency duty team: 01926 886922.</div></details><details><summary>Highlands</summary><div>Highland Child Protection contact listed by WJO: 01349 781410.</div></details><details><summary>Brent / Kilburn area</summary><div>Brent Family Front Door: 020 8937 4300 option 1. Out of hours: 020 8863 5250.</div></details><a class="btn ghost source-button" href="https://wjo.org.uk/safeguarding-policy-children/" target="_blank" rel="noopener">VIEW CURRENT WJO SOURCE POLICY ↗</a></section></div><aside class="policy-sidebar"><div class="sidebar-card"><div class="kicker">On this page</div><a class="policy-jump" href="#ch-commitment">Commitment</a><a class="policy-jump" href="#ch-law">Legal framework</a><a class="policy-jump" href="#ch-abuse">Abuse & poor practice</a><a class="policy-jump" href="#ch-signs">Signs</a><a class="policy-jump" href="#ch-report">Report a concern</a><a class="policy-jump" href="#ch-record">Recording</a><a class="policy-jump" href="#ch-workforce">Recruitment & training</a><a class="policy-jump" href="#ch-contacts">Contacts</a></div></aside></div></div></section></main>`)

routes['safeguarding-adults']=()=>shell(`<main>${pageHero('SAFEGUARDING <em>ADULTS.</em>','Safeguarding / Adults','WJO’s approach to creating a safe and positive environment for adults, including adults with care and support needs.')}<section class="page-section"><div class="wrap"><div class="safeguard-alert"><div class="alert-mark">!</div><div><b>If someone is in immediate danger</b><p>Call the police or ambulance service on 999. Where you suspect a crime is being committed, involve the police.</p></div><a class="btn red" href="tel:999">CALL 999</a></div><div class="policy-meta"><span class="pill">REVIEWED 25/02/2025</span><span class="pill">CARE ACT 2014</span></div><div class="policy-page"><div class="policy-body"><section class="policy-section" id="ad-commitment"><h2>1. Commitment and adult safeguarding</h2><p>WJO's policy commits to a safe, positive environment for all adults involved in Jado Kuin Do, Jado Chi and the wider organisation, in line with the Care Act 2014.</p><p>An adult at risk is described as someone aged 18 or over who has care and support needs, is experiencing or at risk of abuse or neglect, and because of those needs is unable to protect themselves from that risk or experience.</p></section><section class="policy-section" id="ad-principles"><h2>2. Six safeguarding principles</h2><div class="principles-grid"><div class="principle"><b>Empowerment</b><span>Support informed choices and consent.</span></div><div class="principle"><b>Prevention</b><span>Act before harm occurs where possible.</span></div><div class="principle"><b>Proportionality</b><span>Use the least intrusive response appropriate to the risk.</span></div><div class="principle"><b>Protection</b><span>Support those in greatest need.</span></div><div class="principle"><b>Partnership</b><span>Work with communities and services.</span></div><div class="principle"><b>Accountability</b><span>Be clear and transparent about responsibilities.</span></div></div><h3>Making Safeguarding Personal</h3><p>Adult safeguarding should be person-led and outcome-focused. Wherever possible, the adult should be involved in decisions, asked what they would like to happen and supported to retain choice and control.</p></section><section class="policy-section" id="ad-abuse"><h2>3. Types of abuse and neglect</h2><p>The source policy covers a wide range of possible harms, including:</p><div class="contact-list"><div class="contact-item"><b>Self-neglect</b><span>Failure to care for personal health, hygiene or surroundings, including hoarding.</span></div><div class="contact-item"><b>Modern slavery</b><span>Trafficking, forced labour, slavery and domestic servitude.</span></div><div class="contact-item"><b>Domestic abuse</b><span>Psychological, physical, sexual, financial or emotional abuse and coercive control.</span></div><div class="contact-item"><b>Discriminatory abuse</b><span>Abuse connected to protected characteristics or perceived difference.</span></div><div class="contact-item"><b>Organisational abuse</b><span>Neglect or poor care arising from institutional systems or practice.</span></div><div class="contact-item"><b>Physical / sexual abuse</b><span>Physical harm, restraint, sexual harassment, assault or non-consensual sexual activity.</span></div><div class="contact-item"><b>Financial abuse</b><span>Theft, fraud, scams, coercion or misuse of property, money or benefits.</span></div><div class="contact-item"><b>Neglect / psychological abuse</b><span>Ignoring care needs, withholding necessities, threats, humiliation, coercion or isolation.</span></div></div><p>The policy also highlights cyber bullying, forced marriage, mate crime and radicalisation as relevant safeguarding concerns.</p></section><section class="policy-section" id="ad-signs"><h2>4. Possible signs and indicators</h2><ul><li>Unexplained injuries or a lack of medical attention.</li><li>Money or belongings going missing.</li><li>Withdrawal from sessions or changes in confidence and behaviour.</li><li>Unexpected weight or hygiene changes.</li><li>Fear of a particular person or group.</li><li>Self-harm, harassment or a direct disclosure of abuse.</li><li>Training practices that fail to meet the person's needs or involve intentional harm.</li></ul></section><section class="policy-section" id="ad-report"><h2>5. What to do if you have a concern</h2><p>It is not an individual's job to determine whether abuse has occurred, but everyone within WJO has a responsibility to respond to and report concerns.</p><ul><li>In an emergency, call 999.</li><li>Report possible abuse, poor practice or wider welfare concerns to the WJO Designated Safeguarding Lead or Deputy.</li><li>If the safeguarding lead is implicated, escalate through the organisation's senior leadership.</li><li>Where appropriate, ask the adult what outcome they want and keep them informed.</li><li>Listen calmly, avoid leading questions and do not blame the person making the disclosure.</li><li>Serious concerns should be referred to the appropriate statutory agency.</li></ul></section><section class="policy-section" id="ad-record"><h2>6. Recording, consent and information sharing</h2><p>Records should be made promptly, accurately and factually, using the person's words where possible and noting relevant dates, times, names and visible injuries. Records must be stored securely.</p><p>Adult safeguarding differs from child safeguarding because consent and capacity can be central. The source policy says information should normally be shared in line with the adult's wishes where possible, while recognising circumstances where serious risk, lack of capacity, public interest or suspected crime may justify sharing without consent.</p></section><section class="policy-section" id="ad-workforce"><h2>7. Good practice, recruitment and training</h2><p>WJO expects instructors to follow codes of conduct, complete safeguarding awareness training and treat adults equally and with dignity. Safer recruitment, induction, supervised development, ongoing support, whistleblowing and complaints procedures are part of the safeguarding framework.</p></section><section class="policy-section" id="ad-contacts"><h2>8. Useful contacts</h2><div class="contact-list"><div class="contact-item"><b>WJO Safeguarding Officer</b><span>Nicola Ogden</span><span>nicola.ogden@wjo.org.uk</span><span>01327 342611</span></div><div class="contact-item"><b>Ann Craft Trust</b><span>Safeguarding adults in sport and activity</span><span>0115 951 5400</span></div></div><h3>Local adult safeguarding contacts listed by WJO</h3><details><summary>Northamptonshire</summary><div>Adult Care / MASH: 0300 126 1000. Emergency Duty Team: 01604 626938.</div></details><details><summary>Leicester</summary><div>0116 454 1004. Emergency: 0116 255 1606.</div></details><details><summary>Warwickshire</summary><div>Adult Social Care: 01926 412080.</div></details><details><summary>Oxfordshire</summary><div>Raise a concern: 0345 0507 666. Urgent out of hours: 0800 833 408.</div></details><details><summary>Buckinghamshire</summary><div>Safeguarding Adults Team: 0800 137 915.</div></details><details><summary>Hertfordshire</summary><div>Safeguarding Adults Team: 0300 123 4042 (24 hours).</div></details><a class="btn ghost source-button" href="https://wjo.org.uk/safeguarding-policy-adults/" target="_blank" rel="noopener">VIEW CURRENT WJO SOURCE POLICY ↗</a></section></div><aside class="policy-sidebar"><div class="sidebar-card"><div class="kicker">On this page</div><a class="policy-jump" href="#ad-commitment">Commitment</a><a class="policy-jump" href="#ad-principles">Principles</a><a class="policy-jump" href="#ad-abuse">Abuse & neglect</a><a class="policy-jump" href="#ad-signs">Signs</a><a class="policy-jump" href="#ad-report">Report a concern</a><a class="policy-jump" href="#ad-record">Recording & consent</a><a class="policy-jump" href="#ad-workforce">Good practice</a><a class="policy-jump" href="#ad-contacts">Contacts</a></div></aside></div></div></section></main>`)

routes['privacy-notice']=()=>shell(`<main>${pageHero('PRIVACY <em>NOTICE.</em>','Privacy','How the World Jado Organisation collects, uses, stores and protects personal data when you enquire, book a lesson, become a member or use its services.')}<section class="page-section"><div class="wrap"><div class="policy-meta"><span class="pill">WJO PRIVACY NOTICE</span><span class="pill">DATA PROTECTION</span></div><div class="policy-page"><div class="policy-body"><section class="policy-section" id="pr-overview"><h2>1. Important information and who WJO is</h2><p>The privacy notice explains how WJO handles personal data provided through the website, enquiries, lesson bookings and membership. WJO acts as the data controller for personal data collected through these activities.</p><p>The website is not intended for children to contact WJO independently; a parent or legal guardian should make contact when a child wishes to train.</p><div class="safeguard-contact"><div><div class="kicker">Data privacy contact</div><h3>World Jado Kuin Do Organisation</h3><p><a href="mailto:admin@wjo.org.uk">admin@wjo.org.uk</a><br><a href="tel:+441327342611">01327 342611</a></p></div><div><div class="kicker">Your rights</div><h3>Information Commissioner’s Office</h3><p>You can raise data-protection concerns with the ICO. WJO asks that you contact the organisation first so it has an opportunity to address the issue.</p></div></div></section><section class="policy-section" id="pr-data"><h2>2. The data WJO may collect</h2><div class="contact-list"><div class="contact-item"><b>Identity data</b><span>Names, title, date of birth and other information supplied through enquiries or membership, including child/student details provided by a parent or guardian.</span></div><div class="contact-item"><b>Contact data</b><span>Email addresses and telephone numbers.</span></div><div class="contact-item"><b>Training and health data</b><span>Attendance, gradings or assessments and relevant health information needed to assess suitability for training.</span></div><div class="contact-item"><b>Technical and usage data</b><span>Device, browser, IP, site usage and related technical information collected through website technologies and analytics.</span></div><div class="contact-item"><b>Profile and communications data</b><span>Account information, preferences, feedback and marketing/communication choices.</span></div><div class="contact-item"><b>Financial and transaction data</b><span>Payment and purchase information connected with WJO services and products.</span></div></div><p>WJO may also use aggregated or anonymised information for statistical purposes where that information does not identify an individual.</p></section><section class="policy-section" id="pr-collection"><h2>3. How information is collected</h2><p>Personal data can be supplied directly when you attend a trial lesson, make an enquiry, enter a tuition agreement, attend a lesson or grading, request information, subscribe to communications or provide feedback.</p><p>Technical information may also be collected automatically when you use the website. WJO’s notice says information may additionally come from third parties involved in analytics, advertising, payment, delivery and introductory services.</p></section><section class="policy-section" id="pr-use"><h2>4. How WJO uses personal data</h2><ul><li>Responding to enquiries and maintaining prospective-customer records.</li><li>Assessing relevant health information before training.</li><li>Managing membership, tuition, attendance, gradings, transactions and shop purchases.</li><li>Managing the ongoing relationship with members, including service or policy updates.</li><li>Sending optional marketing or information where the appropriate preference or permission exists.</li><li>Operating, securing, troubleshooting and improving the website and WJO services.</li><li>Using analytics to understand and improve services and communications.</li></ul><p>Processing is based on the lawful grounds described in the live notice, including performance of a contract, legitimate interests, consent where applicable and compliance with legal obligations.</p></section><section class="policy-section" id="pr-sharing"><h2>5. Disclosures and third parties</h2><p>WJO may need to share relevant information with organisations that support its services or legal obligations. The live notice includes governing or regulatory bodies, franchisors where applicable, IT and administration providers, professional advisers, payment/service providers and public authorities such as HM Revenue & Customs where required.</p><p>Third-party links have their own privacy notices. WJO does not control the privacy practices of external websites.</p></section><section class="policy-section" id="pr-security"><h2>6. International transfers, security and retention</h2><p>The live privacy notice explains the safeguards that should apply where personal data is transferred internationally. WJO also describes organisational and technical measures intended to prevent personal information being lost, misused, altered, disclosed or accessed without authorisation.</p><p>Personal data should be retained only for as long as reasonably necessary for the purposes for which it was collected, including legal, accounting and reporting requirements.</p></section><section class="policy-section" id="pr-rights"><h2>7. Your legal rights</h2><p>Depending on the circumstances, data-protection law may give you rights to request access, correction, erasure, restriction, transfer or objection to certain processing, and to withdraw consent where consent is the lawful basis being used.</p><p>Keep WJO informed if your personal information changes so records can remain accurate and current.</p></section><section class="policy-section" id="pr-failure"><h2>8. When required information is not provided</h2><p>If WJO needs personal data to meet a legal requirement or perform a contract and that information is not supplied, it may be unable to provide or continue the relevant product or service. The organisation should explain this at the time.</p></section><section class="policy-section" id="pr-source"><h2>9. Current notice and contact</h2><p>This page summarises WJO’s published Privacy Notice. Use the link below to read the full current notice on wjo.org.uk.</p><div class="safeguard-contact"><div><div class="kicker">WJO</div><h3>Privacy enquiries</h3><p><a href="mailto:admin@wjo.org.uk">admin@wjo.org.uk</a><br><a href="tel:+441327342611">01327 342611</a></p></div><div><div class="kicker">Source</div><h3>Current WJO Privacy Notice</h3><p>Open the live notice for the full current wording, glossary, retention, transfer and rights information.</p><a class="btn ghost source-button" href="https://wjo.org.uk/privacy-notice/" target="_blank" rel="noopener">VIEW CURRENT PRIVACY NOTICE ↗</a></div></div></section></div><aside class="policy-sidebar"><div class="sidebar-card"><div class="kicker">On this page</div><a class="policy-jump" href="#pr-overview">Who WJO is</a><a class="policy-jump" href="#pr-data">Data collected</a><a class="policy-jump" href="#pr-collection">How it is collected</a><a class="policy-jump" href="#pr-use">How it is used</a><a class="policy-jump" href="#pr-sharing">Third parties</a><a class="policy-jump" href="#pr-security">Security & retention</a><a class="policy-jump" href="#pr-rights">Your rights</a><a class="policy-jump" href="#pr-source">Current notice</a></div></aside></div></div></section></main>`);

routes.adults=()=>shell(`<main>${pageHero('MODERN <em>TRAINING FOR EVERYDAY LIFE.</em>','Teens + Adults','Practical self-defence, striking, movement, fitness and mindset work delivered in a structured, supportive environment.')}<section class="page-section"><div class="wrap grid-2"><div><div class="kicker">Why adults train</div><h2 style="font-size:52px;line-height:1">Functional skills. Real confidence. Tangible progress.</h2><p style="color:#aeb3bc">The adult programme balances technique, fitness, coordination, self-defence awareness and ongoing personal development. Sessions are accessible for beginners while still giving experienced students room to improve.</p></div><div class="content-card"><h3>What to expect</h3><div class="helper-list"><div>Striking, movement and pad-work</div><div>Practical self-defence applications</div><div>Strength, mobility and conditioning</div><div>Gradings, progression and personal goals</div></div></div></div></section><section class="page-section alt"><div class="wrap"><div class="section-header"><div><div class="kicker">Training approach</div><h2>Core principles of the adult syllabus.</h2></div><p>A modern martial arts system that is straightforward to follow, biomechanically sound and useful in real-world training.</p></div><div class="grid-3"><div class="content-card adult-bg-card" style="--cardbg:url('assets/adults-practical.png');--cardpos:center center"><div class="icon-circle">P</div><h3>Practical</h3><p>Combat application and real-world self-defence.</p></div><div class="content-card adult-bg-card" style="--cardbg:url('assets/adults-efficient.png');--cardpos:right center"><div class="icon-circle">⚡</div><h3>Fast + efficient</h3><p>Powerful movement without wasted energy.</p></div><div class="content-card adult-bg-card" style="--cardbg:url('assets/adults-biomechanical.png');--cardpos:72% center"><div class="icon-circle">◎</div><h3>Bio-mechanical</h3><p>Natural movement built around how the body works.</p></div><div class="content-card adult-bg-card" style="--cardbg:url('assets/adults-mindbody.png');--cardpos:right center"><div class="icon-circle">◐</div><h3>Mind + body</h3><p>Fitness, awareness and mental conditioning together.</p></div><div class="content-card adult-bg-card" style="--cardbg:url('assets/adults-tactical.png');--cardpos:center center"><div class="icon-circle">◇</div><h3>Tactical</h3><p>Awareness, timing and deceptive movement.</p></div><div class="content-card adult-bg-card" style="--cardbg:url('assets/adults-simple.png');--cardpos:right center"><div class="icon-circle">→</div><h3>Simple + direct</h3><p>A clear system designed to be learned progressively.</p></div></div></div></section><section class="page-section cream"><div class="wrap grid-2"><div class="content-card light info-image-card" style="--cardbg:url('assets/tile-self-defence.png');--cardpos:center center"><div class="icon-circle">✓</div><h3>Train for real life</h3><p>Learn movements and responses that are relevant, repeatable and confidence-building.</p></div><div class="content-card light info-image-card" style="--cardbg:url('assets/tile-character.png');--cardpos:center center"><div class="icon-circle">↗</div><h3>Progress at your pace</h3><p>Whether you are brand new or returning to training, classes are structured so you can keep moving forward.</p></div></div></section>${cta()}</main>`)

const ADMIN_DEMO_USER='committee';
const ADMIN_DEMO_PASS='jado2026';
function isAdminLoggedIn(){return localStorage.getItem('wjo-admin-auth')==='yes'}
function adminLogout(){localStorage.removeItem('wjo-admin-auth');location.hash='#admin'}
window.adminLogout=adminLogout;
function submitAdminLogin(e){if(e)e.preventDefault();const user=(document.getElementById('admin-username')?.value||'').trim();const pass=(document.getElementById('admin-password')?.value||'').trim();const msg=document.getElementById('admin-login-message');if(user===ADMIN_DEMO_USER&&pass===ADMIN_DEMO_PASS){localStorage.setItem('wjo-admin-auth','yes');if(msg)msg.textContent='Success — opening the WJO committee hub…';setTimeout(()=>location.hash='#admin-hub',260)}else if(msg){msg.textContent='Use the authorised access details supplied for this build.'}}
window.submitAdminLogin=submitAdminLogin;
function fillAdminDemo(){document.getElementById('admin-username').value=ADMIN_DEMO_USER;document.getElementById('admin-password').value=ADMIN_DEMO_PASS;submitAdminLogin()}
window.fillAdminDemo=fillAdminDemo;

function adminBadge(status){const safe=(status||'').toLowerCase();const cls=safe.includes('live')||safe.includes('published')||safe.includes('open')?'ok':safe.includes('draft')||safe.includes('pending')?'warn':'';return `<span class="status-chip ${cls}">${status}</span>`}
function adminTable(headers,rows){return `<div class="admin-table-wrap"><table class="admin-table"><thead><tr>${headers.map(h=>`<th>${h}</th>`).join('')}</tr></thead><tbody>${rows.join('')}</tbody></table></div>`}
function adminShell(active,title,subtitle,content){
  if(!isAdminLoggedIn()) return routes.admin();
  return shell(`<main>${pageHero('FRONT-END <em>ADMIN.</em>','Committee tools','A front-end management area for authorised WJO users to update website content.')}<section class="page-section"><div class="wrap admin-layout"><aside class="admin-sidebar"><div class="admin-user-pill"><div><b>Committee user</b><span>${ADMIN_DEMO_USER}</span></div><button class="btn ghost" style="min-height:40px;padding:0 12px" onclick="adminLogout()">LOG OUT</button></div><div class="kicker">Management areas</div><nav class="admin-nav"><a class="${active==='hub'?'active':''}" href="#admin-hub">Committee hub<small>Overview, shortcuts and publishing tasks</small></a><a class="${active==='dashboard'?'active':''}" href="#admin-dashboard">Dashboard<small>At-a-glance content totals and workflow</small></a><a class="${active==='news'?'active':''}" href="#admin-news">News & Events<small>Add, edit and publish posts</small></a><a class="${active==='calendar'?'active':''}" href="#admin-calendar">Calendar Editor<small>Month and week views for events</small></a><a class="${active==='media'?'active':''}" href="#admin-media">Media Library<small>Upload and manage images/files</small></a><a class="${active==='jetengine'?'active':''}" href="#admin-jetengine">JetEngine Fields<small>Structured custom post type editor</small></a><a class="${active==='gradings'?'active':''}" href="#admin-gradings">Gradings<small>Dates, venues and event details</small></a><a class="${active==='schools'?'active':''}" href="#admin-schools">School Locations<small>Venue details and schedules</small></a><a class="${active==='instructors'?'active':''}" href="#admin-instructors">Instructors<small>Profiles, roles and photos</small></a><a class="${active==='committee'?'active':''}" href="#admin-committee">Committee<small>Public-facing leadership profiles</small></a></nav><p class="admin-mini-note">Changes in this single-file build are stored locally on this device.</p></aside><div class="admin-main"><div class="admin-command-strip-v49"><div class="admin-command-v49"><b>Content</b><span>News & events</span></div><div class="admin-command-v49"><b>People</b><span>Instructors & committee</span></div><div class="admin-command-v49"><b>Places</b><span>Schools & timetables</span></div><div class="admin-command-v49"><b>Media</b><span>Images & files</span></div></div><div class="admin-frame"><div class="admin-wpbar"><div class="admin-wpbar-left"><span class="admin-wp-pill red">WJO Front-end CMS</span><span class="admin-wp-pill">Signed in as ${ADMIN_DEMO_USER}</span></div><div class="admin-wpbar-right"><input class="admin-wp-search" placeholder="Search content, schools, people…"><span class="admin-wp-pill">Website content</span></div></div><div class="admin-topbar"><div><div class="kicker">${title}</div><h2>${subtitle}</h2><p>Use these screens to add, edit and remove the website content available in this single-file build.</p></div><div class="admin-actions-row"><a class="btn ghost" href="#all-pages">ALL PAGES</a><a class="btn red" href="#contact">CONTACT WJO</a></div></div>${content}</div></div></div></section></main>`)
}

// V31 FINAL CART OVERRIDE — deliberately placed after all legacy cart routes.
routes.cart = () => {
  const items=getCart();
  const rows=items.map(item=>{
    const p=getProduct(item.id);
    const line=p.price*item.qty;
    return `<article class="cart-row cart-row-v30 cart-row-v31">
      <div class="cart-thumb cart-thumb-v30 cart-thumb-v31"><img src="${p.image}" alt="${p.name}"></div>
      <div class="cart-item-info">
        <h3>${p.name}</h3>
        <span>${item.size}</span>
        <button class="cart-remove" type="button" onclick="removeFromCart('${item.id}','${item.size}')">Remove</button>
      </div>
      <div class="cart-item-actions">
        <div class="qty-stepper" aria-label="Quantity">
          <button type="button" aria-label="Decrease quantity" onclick="changeCartQty('${item.id}','${item.size}',-1)">−</button>
          <b>${item.qty}</b>
          <button type="button" aria-label="Increase quantity" onclick="changeCartQty('${item.id}','${item.size}',1)">+</button>
        </div>
        <strong>${money(line)}</strong>
      </div>
    </article>`;
  }).join('');
  const subtotal=items.reduce((sum,item)=>sum+getProduct(item.id).price*item.qty,0);
  return shell(`<main class="cart-page-v30 cart-page-v31">
    ${pageHero('YOUR <em>BASKET.</em>','Shop','Review your items and continue to checkout.')}
    <section class="page-section cart-section-v30">
      <div class="wrap checkout-grid cart-layout-v30">
        <div>
          <div class="cart-table">${items.length?rows:`<div class="cart-empty-v30"><h2>Your basket is empty.</h2><p>Go back to the shop and add uniforms, equipment or membership.</p><a class="btn red" href="#shop">BROWSE SHOP</a></div>`}</div>
          ${items.length?`<a class="continue-shopping-v30" href="#shop">← Continue shopping</a>`:''}
        </div>
        <aside class="summary cart-summary-v30">
          <div class="kicker">Basket summary</div><h3>Order summary</h3>
          <div class="summary-row"><span>Items</span><b>${cartCount()}</b></div>
          <div class="summary-row"><span>Subtotal</span><b>${money(subtotal)}</b></div>
          <div class="summary-row"><span>Delivery</span><b>${items.length?'Calculated next':'—'}</b></div>
          <div class="summary-row cart-total-v30"><span>Total</span><b>${money(subtotal)}</b></div>
          ${items.length?`<a class="btn red cart-checkout-v30" href="#checkout">SECURE CHECKOUT →</a>`:`<a class="btn dark" href="#shop" style="width:100%;margin-top:18px">GO TO SHOP</a>`}
        </aside>
      </div>
    </section>
    ${items.length?`<div class="mobile-cart-checkout-v30"><div><small>${cartCount()} item${cartCount()===1?'':'s'}</small><strong>${money(subtotal)}</strong></div><a href="#checkout">CHECKOUT →</a></div>`:''}
  </main>`);
};
