footer=function(){return `<footer class="footer"><div class="wrap"><div class="footer-grid"><div>${brand()}<p class="footer-brand-copy">Professional martial arts instruction for children, young people and adults — building confidence, resilience and skills for life.</p><div style="margin-top:18px"><div class="kicker">Follow WJO</div>${socialIconsV38()}</div></div><div><h4>Train</h4><a href="#super-js">Super J's</a><a href="#confident-kidz">Confident Kidz</a><a href="#adults">Teens & Adults</a><a href="#chi">Jado Chi</a></div><div><h4>Discover</h4><a href="#about">About WJO</a><a href="#vision">Vision</a><a href="#jado">Jado Kuin Do</a><a href="#instructors">Instructors</a><a href="#leadership">Committee</a></div><div><h4>Members</h4><a href="#events">Gradings & Events</a><a href="#student">Student Zone</a><a href="#training-app">myTraining App</a><a href="#shop">Shop</a><a href="#admin">Admin</a></div><div><h4>Trust & Privacy</h4><a href="#safeguarding">Safeguarding Hub</a><a href="#privacy-notice">Privacy Notice</a><a href="#cookie-policy">Cookie Policy</a><a href="#data-protection">Data Protection & Retention</a><button type="button" onclick="openCookieSettingsV38()" style="border:0;padding:0;background:none;color:inherit;font:inherit;text-align:left;cursor:pointer">Cookie Settings</button><a href="#contact">Contact</a></div></div><div class="footer-bottom"><span>World Jado Organisation • 2026</span><span class="footer-legal-links-v38"><a href="#privacy-notice">Privacy</a><a href="#cookie-policy">Cookies</a><a href="#data-protection">Data protection</a></span></div></div></footer>`};
mobileMenu=function(){return `<div id="mobileMenu" class="mobile-overlay"><div class="mobile-head">${brand()}<button class="close" onclick="closeMenu()">✕</button></div><div class="kicker">Explore WJO</div><nav class="mobile-nav"><a href="#programmes" onclick="closeMenu()">Train <span>→</span></a><a href="#find-school" onclick="closeMenu()">Find a school <span>→</span></a><a href="#about" onclick="closeMenu()">About WJO <span>→</span></a><a href="#instructors" onclick="closeMenu()">Instructors <span>→</span></a><a href="#events" onclick="closeMenu()">Events & gradings <span>→</span></a><a href="#news" onclick="closeMenu()">News <span>→</span></a><a href="#shop" onclick="closeMenu()">Shop <span>→</span></a><a href="#student" class="small" onclick="closeMenu()">Student zone <span>→</span></a><a href="#safeguarding" class="small" onclick="closeMenu()">Safeguarding <span>→</span></a><a href="#admin" class="mobile-admin-v38" onclick="closeMenu()">Admin / Committee Hub <span>→</span></a><a href="#cookie-policy" class="small" onclick="closeMenu()">Cookie policy <span>→</span></a><a href="#data-protection" class="small" onclick="closeMenu()">Data protection <span>→</span></a></nav><div class="mobile-actions"><a class="btn red" href="#find-school" onclick="closeMenu()">BOOK A FREE TASTER</a></div><div class="mobile-socials"><div class="kicker">Follow WJO</div>${socialIconsV38()}</div></div>`};

function getCookiePrefsV38(){try{return JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('wjo-cookie-prefs-v52')||'null')}catch(e){return null}}
function setCookiePrefsV38(p){try{localStorage.setItem('wjo-cookie-prefs-v52',JSON.stringify(p))}catch(e){} render()}
function cookieBannerV38(){if(getCookiePrefsV38())return '';return `<div class="cookie-banner-v38"><div><h3>Cookies &amp; privacy</h3><p>We use essential storage for core site functions. Optional analytics and marketing technologies are controlled by your cookie choices. <a class="cookie-policy-link-v52" href="#cookie-policy">Read our Cookie Policy</a> or <a class="cookie-policy-link-v52" href="#privacy-notice">Privacy Notice</a>.</p></div><div class="cookie-actions-v38"><button class="reject" onclick="setCookiePrefsV38({essential:true,analytics:false,marketing:false})">Reject non-essential</button><button onclick="openCookieSettingsV38()">Manage cookies</button><button class="accept" onclick="setCookiePrefsV38({essential:true,analytics:true,marketing:true})">Accept all</button></div></div>`}
function cookieModalV38(){const p=getCookiePrefsV38()||{essential:true,analytics:false,marketing:false};return `<div id="cookie-modal-v38" class="cookie-modal-v38" onclick="if(event.target===this)closeCookieSettingsV38()"><div class="cookie-panel-v38"><h2>Cookie preferences</h2><p>Choose which optional technologies WJO may use. Essential storage is always on because it supports core site functions.</p><div class="cookie-option-v38"><div><h4>Essential</h4><p>Login/session security, basket state and remembering your privacy choice.</p></div><button class="cookie-toggle-v38 on locked" aria-label="Essential cookies always on"></button></div><div class="cookie-option-v38"><div><h4>Analytics</h4><p>Helps understand how visitors use the site. The current WJO privacy notice refers to Google Analytics.</p></div><button id="cookie-analytics-v38" class="cookie-toggle-v38 ${p.analytics?'on':''}" onclick="this.classList.toggle('on')" aria-label="Toggle analytics"></button></div><div class="cookie-option-v38"><div><h4>Marketing</h4><p>Advertising and conversion technologies. The current WJO privacy notice refers to Google Advertising and Facebook Pixel.</p></div><button id="cookie-marketing-v38" class="cookie-toggle-v38 ${p.marketing?'on':''}" onclick="this.classList.toggle('on')" aria-label="Toggle marketing"></button></div><div class="cookie-modal-actions-v38"><button onclick="closeCookieSettingsV38()">Cancel</button><button onclick="setCookiePrefsV38({essential:true,analytics:false,marketing:false});closeCookieSettingsV38()">Reject optional</button><button class="save" onclick="saveCookieSettingsV38()">Save preferences</button></div></div></div>`}
function openCookieSettingsV38(){document.getElementById('cookie-modal-v38')?.classList.add('open')}
function closeCookieSettingsV38(){document.getElementById('cookie-modal-v38')?.classList.remove('open')}
function saveCookieSettingsV38(){setCookiePrefsV38({essential:true,analytics:document.getElementById('cookie-analytics-v38')?.classList.contains('on')||false,marketing:document.getElementById('cookie-marketing-v38')?.classList.contains('on')||false});closeCookieSettingsV38()}
window.openCookieSettingsV38=openCookieSettingsV38;window.closeCookieSettingsV38=closeCookieSettingsV38;window.saveCookieSettingsV38=saveCookieSettingsV38;window.setCookiePrefsV38=setCookiePrefsV38;


// ===== V40 newsletter popup =====
let newsletterTimerV40=null;
let newsletterRetryV40=null;
function newsletterPopupV40(){return `<aside id="newsletter-popup-v40" class="newsletter-popup-v40" aria-label="Join our newsletter" aria-live="polite"><button class="newsletter-close-v40" type="button" onclick="dismissNewsletterV40()" aria-label="Close newsletter">×</button><div class="newsletter-copy-v40"><div class="newsletter-kicker-v40">Stay connected</div><h3>Join the WJO newsletter.</h3><p>Get organisation news, grading information, events and useful updates from the WJO community.</p></div><form class="newsletter-form-v40" onsubmit="submitNewsletterV40(event)"><input id="newsletter-email-v40" type="email" autocomplete="email" placeholder="Your email address" required><button class="newsletter-submit-v40" type="submit">JOIN NOW</button><label class="newsletter-consent-v40"><input id="newsletter-consent-v40" type="checkbox" required><span>I would like to receive WJO news and updates by email. I understand I can unsubscribe at any time. See the <a href="#privacy-notice" onclick="dismissNewsletterV40()">Privacy Notice</a>.</span></label><div id="newsletter-message-v40" class="newsletter-message-v40"></div></form><div class="newsletter-success-v40"><b>Thank you for joining.</b><p>Thank you. Your newsletter preference has been saved.</p></div><p class="newsletter-demo-note-v40">Newsletter preferences in this single-file version are stored on this device.</p></aside>`}
function newsletterSubscribedV40(){try{return localStorage.getItem('wjo-newsletter-subscribed-v40')==='yes'}catch(e){return false}}
function newsletterDismissedV40(){try{return sessionStorage.getItem('wjo-newsletter-dismissed-v40')==='yes'}catch(e){return false}}
function showNewsletterV40(force=false){const el=document.getElementById('newsletter-popup-v40');if(!el)return;if(!force&&(newsletterSubscribedV40()||newsletterDismissedV40()))return;el.classList.add('show');if(force){try{sessionStorage.removeItem('wjo-newsletter-dismissed-v40')}catch(e){}}}
function dismissNewsletterV40(){document.getElementById('newsletter-popup-v40')?.classList.remove('show');try{sessionStorage.setItem('wjo-newsletter-dismissed-v40','yes')}catch(e){}}
function submitNewsletterV40(e){e?.preventDefault();const email=document.getElementById('newsletter-email-v40');const consent=document.getElementById('newsletter-consent-v40');const msg=document.getElementById('newsletter-message-v40');if(!email?.value||!email.checkValidity()){if(msg)msg.textContent='Please enter a valid email address.';email?.focus();return}if(!consent?.checked){if(msg)msg.textContent='Please confirm that you would like to receive email updates.';consent?.focus();return}try{localStorage.setItem('wjo-newsletter-subscribed-v40','yes')}catch(err){}const el=document.getElementById('newsletter-popup-v40');if(el){el.classList.add('success','show')}if(msg)msg.textContent=''}
function tryNewsletterV40(){if(newsletterSubscribedV40()||newsletterDismissedV40())return;const cookie=document.querySelector('.cookie-banner-v38');if(cookie){clearTimeout(newsletterRetryV40);newsletterRetryV40=setTimeout(tryNewsletterV40,2500);return}showNewsletterV40(false)}
function scheduleNewsletterV40(){if(newsletterTimerV40||newsletterSubscribedV40()||newsletterDismissedV40())return;newsletterTimerV40=setTimeout(tryNewsletterV40,20000)}
window.showNewsletterV40=showNewsletterV40;window.dismissNewsletterV40=dismissNewsletterV40;window.submitNewsletterV40=submitNewsletterV40;

shell=function(body){return header()+body+footer()+mobileMenu()+cookieBannerV38()+cookieModalV38()+newsletterPopupV40()+`<button class="mobile-menu-fab" type="button" onclick="openMenu()" aria-label="Open menu"><span class="bars"><i></i><i></i><i></i></span><small>MENU</small></button>`};

routes['cookie-policy']=()=>shell(`<main>${pageHero('COOKIE <em>POLICY.</em>','Privacy & cookies','A clear explanation of the technologies the WJO website may use and how visitors can control optional analytics and marketing cookies.')}<section class="page-section"><div class="wrap"><div class="legal-callout-v38"><b>Cookie information</b>WJO’s published Privacy Notice identifies Google Analytics cookies, Google Advertising cookies and Facebook Pixel, and explains that browser controls can refuse cookies.</div><div class="policy-page"><div class="policy-body"><section class="policy-section"><h2>1. What cookies and similar technologies are</h2><p>Cookies and related storage technologies can remember choices, keep sessions secure, measure website use and support advertising. Essential technologies may be required for core functions; optional analytics and marketing technologies should be controlled through clear visitor choices.</p></section><section class="policy-section"><h2>2. Cookie choices</h2><ul><li>Essential technologies remain available where needed for core site operation.</li><li>Analytics and marketing categories are off until the visitor chooses them.</li><li>Visitors can reject non-essential technologies as easily as accepting them.</li><li>Preferences can be changed later using the Cookie Settings link in the footer.</li><li>Consent choices should be recorded so WJO can demonstrate how optional tracking was enabled.</li></ul><button class="btn red" type="button" onclick="openCookieSettingsV38()">OPEN COOKIE SETTINGS</button></section><section class="policy-section"><h2>3. Cookie categories</h2><div style="overflow:auto"><table class="cookie-table-v38"><thead><tr><th>Category</th><th>Purpose</th><th>Default</th><th>Examples named in WJO’s published notice</th></tr></thead><tbody><tr><td><b>Essential</b></td><td>Security, session/login state, basket functionality and remembering privacy choices.</td><td><span class="cookie-status-v38">Always available</span></td><td>Session identifiers, authentication and cookie preference storage.</td></tr><tr><td><b>Analytics</b></td><td>Understand visits and improve pages and journeys.</td><td><span class="cookie-status-v38 consent">Consent first</span></td><td>Google Analytics if retained in the final build.</td></tr><tr><td><b>Marketing</b></td><td>Measure campaigns and support relevant advertising.</td><td><span class="cookie-status-v38 consent">Consent first</span></td><td>Google advertising technologies and Meta/Facebook Pixel if retained.</td></tr><tr><td><b>Third-party media</b></td><td>Video or other embedded services can set their own technologies.</td><td><span class="cookie-status-v38 consent">Review / consent</span></td><td>YouTube or other embedded providers if direct embeds are used.</td></tr></tbody></table></div></section><section class="policy-section"><h2>4. Current WJO references that need to be carried forward carefully</h2><p>The existing WJO privacy notice refers to Google Analytics, Google Advertising cookies and Facebook Pixel, and tells visitors to see a cookie policy for more information. The rebuilt site should confirm whether those services are still genuinely used before listing or loading them.</p></section><section class="policy-section"><h2>5. Controlling and withdrawing consent</h2><p>Visitors should be able to revisit their choices at any time. Browser controls can also block or remove cookies, although blocking essential technologies may affect parts of the site.</p></section></div><aside class="policy-sidebar"><div class="sidebar-card"><div class="kicker">Privacy controls</div><a class="policy-jump" href="#privacy-notice">Privacy Notice</a><a class="policy-jump" href="#data-protection">Data Protection & Retention</a><button class="btn red" type="button" onclick="openCookieSettingsV38()" style="margin-top:12px">COOKIE SETTINGS</button></div></aside></div></div></section></main>`);

routes['data-protection']=()=>shell(`<main>${pageHero('DATA PROTECTION <em>& RETENTION.</em>','Privacy / customer data','How WJO’s published Privacy Notice describes personal-data handling and retention.')}<section class="page-section"><div class="wrap"><div class="legal-callout-v38"><b>Compliance design, not legal sign-off</b>WJO is UK-based, so the final system should be reviewed primarily against UK GDPR, the Data Protection Act 2018 and applicable electronic-communications rules. EU GDPR may also apply where WJO offers services to or monitors people in the EU/EEA. Final retention periods, processors and international transfer wording must match WJO’s real operations.</div><div class="policy-page"><div class="policy-body"><section class="policy-section"><h2>1. Privacy by design</h2><p>WJO’s published notice explains the purposes for collecting personal information, asks people to keep records accurate and current, and states that data is retained only as long as necessary.</p><div class="principles-grid"><div class="principle"><b>Lawful & transparent</b><span>Tell people what is collected, why, and the lawful basis.</span></div><div class="principle"><b>Data minimisation</b><span>Do not ask for information that is not necessary.</span></div><div class="principle"><b>Storage limitation</b><span>Use documented retention rules rather than keeping records indefinitely.</span></div><div class="principle"><b>Security</b><span>Role-based access, strong authentication, backups and breach procedures.</span></div></div></section><section class="policy-section"><h2>2. Customer and member information likely to be held</h2><ul><li>Parent, guardian, student and member identity/contact details.</li><li>School, class, attendance, grading and membership records.</li><li>Relevant health or emergency information needed to support safe participation; this needs heightened access control.</li><li>Orders, payments and transaction records. The website should avoid storing full card details itself where a compliant payment provider can process them.</li><li>Enquiries, trial bookings, consent choices and communication preferences.</li><li>Safeguarding information where necessary, under a separate restricted safeguarding process and retention schedule.</li><li>Technical/security logs and, where consented, analytics or marketing data.</li></ul></section><section class="policy-section"><h2>3. Data retention</h2><p>WJO’s published notice says retention periods depend on the purpose, nature and sensitivity of the data, risk and applicable legal requirements. More detailed retention periods are available in WJO’s Retention Policy on request.</p><div style="overflow:auto"><table class="retention-table-v38"><thead><tr><th>Record type</th><th>Published approach</th><th>System action</th></tr></thead><tbody><tr><td><b>Enquiries / trial requests</b></td><td>Keep only while the enquiry is active plus a short, documented follow-up period unless the person becomes a member.</td><td>Automatic review / deletion flag.</td></tr><tr><td><b>Active membership & training records</b></td><td>Retain while needed to deliver membership, grading and training services, then apply the approved post-membership retention schedule.</td><td>Archive on leaving; review at expiry.</td></tr><tr><td><b>Financial / transaction records</b></td><td>Retain for the period required by accounting, tax, contractual and audit obligations.</td><td>Restricted finance access; scheduled review.</td></tr><tr><td><b>Health / emergency details</b></td><td>Keep only while required for safe participation and review frequently because the information may be sensitive and can change.</td><td>Restricted field permissions and expiry review.</td></tr><tr><td><b>Marketing preferences</b></td><td>Keep active consent/preferences while relevant; retain the minimum suppression record needed to respect an opt-out.</td><td>Preference centre and audit timestamp.</td></tr><tr><td><b>Safeguarding records</b></td><td>Use a dedicated safeguarding retention policy reflecting legal and sector guidance; do not apply a generic website deletion rule.</td><td>Separate restricted record store.</td></tr><tr><td><b>Analytics / tracking</b></td><td>Only after the required consent; use the shortest suitable provider settings and document them in the cookie policy.</td><td>Consent-gated loading and expiry settings.</td></tr></tbody></table></div></section><section class="policy-section"><h2>4. Individual rights</h2><p>The final privacy workflow should support requests for access, correction, erasure where applicable, restriction, objection, portability where applicable, and withdrawal of consent. Requests should be logged, identity-checked where necessary and handled within the applicable legal timescale.</p></section><section class="policy-section"><h2>5. Children and sensitive information</h2><p>Because WJO teaches children and may hold health or safeguarding information, the final system should use particularly clear privacy information for parents/guardians, collect the minimum necessary data, and restrict sensitive records to authorised people. Safeguarding records should not be exposed through ordinary school-editor accounts.</p></section><section class="policy-section"><h2>6. Hosting, processors and international transfers</h2><p>Before launch, WJO should document where the website, backups, membership platform, email, payment, analytics and media services store or access personal data. If data is transferred outside the UK or, where relevant, outside the EU/EEA, WJO should confirm that the appropriate lawful transfer mechanism and safeguards are in place. The wording should describe the actual providers used rather than relying on older generic statements.</p></section><section class="policy-section"><h2>7. Administration and security</h2><ul><li>Named user accounts rather than shared passwords.</li><li>Role-based permissions for committee, regional managers, school editors, finance and safeguarding users.</li><li>Audit trail for create, edit, publish, delete and consent changes.</li><li>Two-factor authentication for privileged accounts in the final system.</li><li>Automatic retention/review dates on custom post types that contain personal data.</li><li>Encrypted transport (HTTPS), secure backups and a documented breach-response process.</li></ul></section></div><aside class="policy-sidebar"><div class="sidebar-card"><div class="kicker">Privacy hub</div><a class="policy-jump" href="#privacy-notice">Privacy Notice</a><a class="policy-jump" href="#cookie-policy">Cookie Policy</a><button class="btn red" type="button" onclick="openCookieSettingsV38()" style="margin-top:12px">COOKIE SETTINGS</button></div></aside></div></div></section></main>`);

if(typeof V10_PAGE_INDEX!=='undefined'){if(!V10_PAGE_INDEX.some(x=>x[1]==='cookie-policy'))V10_PAGE_INDEX.push(['Cookie Policy','cookie-policy']);if(!V10_PAGE_INDEX.some(x=>x[1]==='data-protection'))V10_PAGE_INDEX.push(['Data Protection & Retention','data-protection']);}

adminShell=function(active,title,subtitle,content){if(!isAdminLoggedIn())return routes.admin();return `<div class="prod-admin-app"><header class="prod-admin-top"><div class="prod-admin-brand"><img src="${V38_LOGO}" alt="WJO"><div><strong>WJO Administration</strong><span>Committee content management</span></div></div><div class="prod-admin-top-actions"><a href="#home">View website</a><button onclick="adminLogout()">Sign out</button><a class="primary" href="#admin-news">+ Add content</a></div></header><div class="prod-admin-shell"><aside class="prod-admin-side"><div class="prod-admin-user"><div class="prod-admin-avatar">C</div><div><b>Committee User</b><span>Administrator</span></div></div><div class="prod-admin-section-label">Website content</div>${prodAdminNavV38(active)}<div class="prod-admin-section-label">Privacy</div><nav class="prod-admin-nav"><a href="#cookie-policy"><span class="nav-dot"></span>Cookie Policy</a><a href="#data-protection"><span class="nav-dot"></span>Data Protection</a></nav></aside><main class="prod-admin-main"><div class="prod-admin-breadcrumb"><span>WJO Admin</span><span>›</span><span>${subtitle}</span></div><div class="prod-admin-titlebar"><div><h1>${subtitle}</h1><p>${title} — manage the live website from a simple committee-facing workspace.</p></div><div class="prod-admin-page-actions"><a href="#home">Preview site</a><a class="primary" href="#admin-news">Add new</a></div></div>${content}</main></div></div>`};
routes.admin=()=>`<div class="prod-admin-login"><div class="prod-login-card"><div class="prod-login-logo"><img src="${V38_LOGO}" alt="Jado Kuin Do"></div><h1>WJO Administration</h1><p>Secure committee access to news, events, gradings, school locations and people profiles.</p><form class="prod-login-fields" onsubmit="submitAdminLogin(event)"><div><label for="admin-username">Username</label><input id="admin-username" autocomplete="username" placeholder="Username"></div><div><label for="admin-password">Password</label><input id="admin-password" type="password" autocomplete="current-password" placeholder="Password"></div><button class="login-submit" type="submit">Sign in</button></form><div class="prod-login-demo"><b>Committee login</b><br>Username: <b>${ADMIN_DEMO_USER}</b> &nbsp; Password: <b>${ADMIN_DEMO_PASS}</b><br><button type="button" onclick="fillAdminDemo()" style="margin-top:8px;border:0;background:none;color:#c51e27;font-weight:900;cursor:pointer;padding:0">Use access details</button><div id="admin-login-message" style="margin-top:7px;color:#66717d"></div></div><a class="prod-login-back" href="#home">← Back to website</a></div></div>`;

routes.contact=()=>shell(`<main>${pageHero('LET’S TALK <em>JADO.</em>','Contact WJO','Choose the right route for general enquiries, local classes, safeguarding or shop support.')}<section class="page-section"><div class="wrap grid-2"><div class="content-card"><h2>Send a message</h2><div class="form-grid"><input class="field" placeholder="Your name"><input class="field" placeholder="Email"><input class="field wide" placeholder="Phone"><select class="field wide"><option>General enquiry</option><option>Find a class</option><option>Safeguarding</option><option>Shop order</option><option>Data protection / privacy</option></select><textarea class="field wide" rows="6" placeholder="How can we help?"></textarea><button class="btn red wide">SEND ENQUIRY</button></div></div><div><div class="content-card"><div class="kicker">Head office</div><h3>World Jado Kuin Do Organisation</h3><p>PO Box 290<br>Holmfirth<br>HD9 9FL</p><p><b>01327 342611</b><br>admin@wjo.org.uk</p><div class="kicker" style="margin-top:20px">Follow WJO</div>${socialIconsV38()}</div><div class="content-card" style="margin-top:14px"><div class="kicker">Privacy</div><h3>Your data and choices</h3><p>Read WJO privacy and cookie information or change your cookie preferences.</p><div class="admin-actions-row"><a class="btn ghost" href="#privacy-notice">PRIVACY</a><a class="btn ghost" href="#cookie-policy">COOKIES</a><a class="btn ghost" href="#data-protection">DATA</a></div></div></div></div></section></main>`);

function render(){const raw=(location.hash||'#home').slice(1);const key=raw.split('?')[0]||'home';const fn=routes[key]||routes.home;document.getElementById('site').innerHTML=resolveAssets(fn())+cookieQuickLinkV52();if(key==='find-school')setTimeout(initSchoolFinder,0);window.scrollTo(0,0);if(key==='shop'&&hashParams().get('scroll')==='products')setTimeout(()=>document.getElementById('shop-products')?.scrollIntoView({behavior:'smooth',block:'start'}),90);if(location.hash.includes('menu=open')) setTimeout(openMenu,40)}
function showWjoIntroV29(){
 if(document.getElementById('wjo-intro-v29'))return;
 const intro=document.createElement('div');intro.id='wjo-intro-v29';intro.className='wjo-intro-v29';
 intro.innerHTML=`<div class="wjo-intro-card-v29"><button class="wjo-intro-skip-v29" type="button" onclick="dismissWjoIntroV29()">SKIP</button><img class="wjo-intro-crest-v29" src="${V38_LOGO}" alt="Jado Kuin Do"><div class="wjo-intro-quote-v29">Inspiring healthier communities by teaching life skills, personal growth, well-being, and unity.</div><div class="wjo-intro-name-v29">Grand Master Jake Ogden</div><div class="wjo-intro-title-v29">Founder &amp; President • World Jado Organisation</div></div>`;
 document.body.appendChild(intro);
}

// ========================= V41 FUNCTIONAL LOCAL CMS =========================
const WJO_CMS_KEY='wjo-v44-local-cms';
const WJO_CMS_PREVIOUS_KEY='wjo-v43-local-cms';
const WJO_CMS_VERSION=44;
function cmsSlug(v){return String(v||'item').toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g,'-').replace(/^-|-$/g,'').slice(0,48)||'item'}
function cmsClone(v){return JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(v))}
function cmsSeedData(){
  const news=[
    {id:'mental-health-january',title:'Why Jado Kuin Do matters for mental health',category:'Wellbeing',status:'Published',date:'2026-01-11',author:'WJO Editorial',summary:'How training supports focus, routine, confidence, emotional balance and a sense of belonging.',body:'Martial arts training can offer much more than physical exercise. A regular class gives students structure, achievable goals and a positive place to focus their energy.\n\nFor younger students, learning new skills and progressing through the syllabus can strengthen confidence and provide a sense of achievement. For adults, training can create valuable time away from day-to-day pressures while encouraging concentration, movement and self-discipline.\n\nThe social side of Jado Kuin Do is equally important. Training alongside others, supporting classmates and working towards shared goals can help create a genuine sense of belonging. WJO aims to provide a welcoming environment where students can develop at their own pace and build skills that extend beyond the training hall.',image:'assets/news-mental.jpg',seed:true},
    {id:'jado-january-newsletter',title:'Jado January Newsletter',category:'WJO News',status:'Published',date:'2026-01-08',author:'Nicola Ogden',summary:'The latest organisation updates, training news and instructor development.',body:'Welcome to the latest WJO newsletter. Across the organisation, clubs continue to train, develop and support students through classes, gradings, seminars and community events.\n\nThis edition brings together organisation updates, upcoming opportunities and news from across the WJO network. It is also a chance to recognise the work of instructors and volunteers who help make each club a positive place to train.\n\nKeep an eye on the Events and Gradings calendar for upcoming dates, and speak to your local instructor if you have any questions about your next stage of training.',image:'assets/news-newsletter.jpg',seed:true},
    {id:'reflection-2025',title:'2025 reflection letter',category:'From the Founder',status:'Published',date:'2025-12-28',author:'Grand Master Jake Ogden',summary:'Grand Master Ogden reflects on growth, standards, community and WJO values.',body:'As another year comes to a close, it is a good opportunity to reflect on what has been achieved across the WJO community. The organisation continues to grow, but the values behind Jado Kuin Do remain at the centre of everything we do.\n\nHigh standards, personal development and respect for one another matter just as much as technical progress. Every student who steps onto the training floor is on an individual journey, and every instructor has a responsibility to help that journey develop positively.\n\nThank you to our students, parents, instructors, committee members and supporters for the time and energy you have given throughout the year. I look forward to seeing what we continue to build together.',image:'assets/news-reflection.jpg',seed:true},
    {id:'fun-awareness-day',title:'Fun & Awareness Day',category:'Community',status:'Published',date:'2026-03-21',author:'WJO Community',summary:'Daventry students, families and local services came together for a community event.',body:'Students, families and members of the local community came together for a day focused on fun, awareness and positive community involvement.\n\nThe event gave visitors an opportunity to meet people from across the WJO community, learn more about martial arts training and spend time together away from normal weekly classes. Activities were designed to be welcoming for both existing members and people discovering Jado for the first time.\n\nCommunity events are an important part of WJO. They give clubs the chance to build stronger relationships, support local families and show that martial arts can have a positive role far beyond the training hall.',image:'assets/news-newsletter.jpg',seed:true},
    {id:'social-character',title:'Social development and character building',category:'Development',status:'Published',date:'2026-04-12',author:'WJO Editorial',summary:'How Jado training develops confidence, belonging and life skills alongside technique.',body:'Learning martial arts is not only about punches, kicks or combinations. Students also practise listening, perseverance, teamwork and self-control every time they train.\n\nProgress comes through repeated small challenges: learning something unfamiliar, trying again after a mistake and eventually achieving a goal that once felt difficult. Over time, those experiences can help students become more confident in their own ability.\n\nThe training environment also creates opportunities to communicate with different age groups, support training partners and become part of a wider community. Those qualities are a significant part of the character-building approach within Jado Kuin Do.',image:'assets/value-improvement-v2.png',seed:true}
  ];
  const events=(typeof LIVE_EVENTS!=='undefined'?LIVE_EVENTS:[]).map(e=>({...cmsClone(e),status:'Published',seed:true}));
  const gradings=[{id:'grading-regional-day',title:'Regional Grading Day',region:'Northamptonshire',venue:'Daventry Community Centre',date:'2026-10-12',status:'Open',notes:'Regional grading session for eligible WJO students.',seed:true},{id:'grading-junior-awards',title:'Junior Awards Session',region:'Oxfordshire',venue:'Bicester Leisure Centre',date:'2026-10-19',status:'Open',notes:'Junior awards and grading session.',seed:true},{id:'grading-black-belt-prep',title:'Black Belt Assessment Prep',region:'WJO-wide',venue:'Central Seminar Venue',date:'2026-11-02',status:'Open',notes:'Preparation session for upcoming Black Belt assessments.',seed:true}];
  const schools=(typeof SCHOOLS!=='undefined'?SCHOOLS:[]).map(x=>({...cmsClone(x),status:'Live',seed:true}));
  const instructors=(typeof VERIFIED_INSTRUCTORS!=='undefined'?VERIFIED_INSTRUCTORS:[]).map((x,i)=>({id:'instructor-'+cmsSlug(x.name)+'-'+i,name:x.name,role:x.role||'Instructor',school:(x.locations||[]).join(' / '),status:'Live',summary:x.summary||'',photo:x.photo||x.fallback||'',seed:true}));
  const committee=[
    {id:'committee-jake-ogden',name:'Grand Master Jake Ogden',role:'Founder & President',visibility:'Public',status:'Live',summary:'Founder of the World Jado Organisation, creator of Jado Kuin Do and 9th Degree Black Belt.',photo:(typeof V3_COMMITTEE_IMAGES!=='undefined'?V3_COMMITTEE_IMAGES.founder:''),seed:true},
    {id:'committee-nicola-ogden',name:'Mrs Nicola Ogden',role:'Chief Operating Officer',visibility:'Public',status:'Live',summary:'Designated Safeguarding Lead and 1st Degree Black Belt.',photo:(typeof V3_COMMITTEE_IMAGES!=='undefined'?V3_COMMITTEE_IMAGES.nicola:''),seed:true},
    {id:'committee-neal-worth',name:'Sifu Neal Worth',role:'Executive Committee',visibility:'Public',status:'Live',summary:'Jado Guardian, grading examiner and 5th Degree Black Belt.',photo:(typeof V3_COMMITTEE_IMAGES!=='undefined'?V3_COMMITTEE_IMAGES.neal:''),seed:true},
    {id:'committee-hazel-williams',name:'Sifu Hazel Williams',role:'Executive Committee',visibility:'Public',status:'Live',summary:'Jado Guardian, lead grading examiner and 5th Degree Black Belt.',photo:(typeof V3_COMMITTEE_IMAGES!=='undefined'?V3_COMMITTEE_IMAGES.hazel:''),seed:true},
    {id:'committee-jake-springthorpe',name:'Sifu Jake Springthorpe BSc',role:'Grading Committee',visibility:'Public',status:'Live',summary:'Senior instructor and 4th Degree Black Belt.',photo:(typeof V3_COMMITTEE_IMAGES!=='undefined'?V3_COMMITTEE_IMAGES.jakes:''),seed:true},
    {id:'committee-kevin-rattigan',name:'Sifu Kevin Rattigan',role:'Grading Examination Team',visibility:'Public',status:'Live',summary:'Senior instructor and 4th Degree Black Belt.',photo:(typeof V3_COMMITTEE_IMAGES!=='undefined'?V3_COMMITTEE_IMAGES.kevin:''),seed:true}
  ];
  return {version:WJO_CMS_VERSION,updatedAt:new Date().toISOString(),news,events,gradings,schools,instructors,committee};
}
let WJO_CMS_MEMORY=null;
function cmsStorageGet(){try{return localStorage.getItem(WJO_CMS_KEY)}catch(e){return WJO_CMS_MEMORY}}
function cmsStorageSet(raw){try{localStorage.setItem(WJO_CMS_KEY,raw);return true}catch(e){WJO_CMS_MEMORY=raw;return false}}
function cmsLoad(){
  try{
    const raw=cmsStorageGet();
    if(raw){const d=JSON.parse(raw);if(d&&d.version===WJO_CMS_VERSION)return d}
    let previous=null;
    try{previous=localStorage.getItem(WJO_CMS_PREVIOUS_KEY)}catch(e){}
    if(previous){
      const d=JSON.parse(previous);
      if(d&&Array.isArray(d.news)&&Array.isArray(d.schools)){
        const seed=cmsSeedData();
        const bodyById=Object.fromEntries(seed.news.map(x=>[x.id,x.body||'']));
        d.news=d.news.map(x=>({...x,body:x.body||bodyById[x.id]||x.summary||''}));
        d.version=WJO_CMS_VERSION;
        d.updatedAt=new Date().toISOString();
        cmsStorageSet(JSON.stringify(d));
        return d;
      }
    }
  }catch(e){}
  const d=cmsSeedData();cmsStorageSet(JSON.stringify(d));return d
}
function cmsSaveData(d){d.version=WJO_CMS_VERSION;d.updatedAt=new Date().toISOString();cmsStorageSet(JSON.stringify(d));window.WJO_CMS_DATA=d;return d}
window.WJO_CMS_DATA=cmsLoad();
function cmsData(){return window.WJO_CMS_DATA||cmsLoad()}
function cmsNotify(title,msg){let t=document.getElementById('cms-toast-v41');if(!t){t=document.createElement('div');t.id='cms-toast-v41';t.className='cms-toast';document.body.appendChild(t)}t.innerHTML=`<b>${title}</b><span>${msg||''}</span>`;t.classList.add('show');clearTimeout(window._cmsToastTimer);window._cmsToastTimer=setTimeout(()=>t.classList.remove('show'),2600)}
function cmsCollection(type){const d=cmsData();return Array.isArray(d[type])?d[type]:[]}
function cmsRecord(type,id){return cmsCollection(type).find(x=>x.id===id)}
function cmsUpsert(type,record){const d=cmsData();const list=d[type]||[];const idx=list.findIndex(x=>x.id===record.id);if(idx>=0)list[idx]={...list[idx],...record,seed:false,updatedAt:new Date().toISOString()};else list.unshift({...record,seed:false,updatedAt:new Date().toISOString()});d[type]=list;cmsSaveData(d);cmsNotify('Saved to local content','The website has been updated.');}
function cmsRemove(type,id){const d=cmsData();d[type]=(d[type]||[]).filter(x=>x.id!==id);cmsSaveData(d);cmsNotify('Item deleted','The website has been updated.');}
function cmsResetData(){if(!confirm('Reset local content back to the supplied WJO records?'))return;const d=cmsSeedData();cmsSaveData(d);cmsNotify('Local content reset','All local changes have been cleared.');render()}
window.cmsResetData=cmsResetData;
function cmsExportData(){const d=cmsData();const blob=new Blob([JSON.stringify(d,null,2)],{type:'application/json'});const a=document.createElement('a');a.href=URL.createObjectURL(blob);a.download='wjo-content-v59.json';a.click();setTimeout(()=>URL.revokeObjectURL(a.href),1000);cmsNotify('Backup created','The current local content was exported as JSON.')}
window.cmsExportData=cmsExportData;
function cmsImportDataInput(input){const f=input.files?.[0];if(!f)return;const r=new FileReader();r.onload=()=>{try{const d=JSON.parse(r.result);if(!d||!d.news||!d.events)throw new Error('Invalid file');d.version=WJO_CMS_VERSION;cmsSaveData(d);cmsNotify('Backup imported','The local content store now uses the imported data.');render()}catch(e){alert('That file is not a valid WJO backup.')}};r.readAsText(f)}
window.cmsImportDataInput=cmsImportDataInput;
function cmsBackupControls(){return `<div class="cms-data-actions"><button class="btn ghost" type="button" onclick="cmsExportData()">EXPORT JSON</button><label class="btn ghost" style="cursor:pointer">IMPORT JSON<input type="file" accept="application/json" style="display:none" onchange="cmsImportDataInput(this)"></label><button class="btn dark" type="button" onclick="cmsResetData()">RESET LOCAL CONTENT</button></div>`}
function cmsLiveStrip(){const d=cmsData();return `<div class="cms-live-strip"><div><strong>Local content store connected</strong><span> • Changes are stored on this device and instantly reflected on the website.</span></div>${cmsBackupControls()}</div>`}
function cmsId(type,title){return type+'-'+cmsSlug(title)+'-'+Date.now().toString(36)}
function cmsEscape(v){return String(v??'').replace(/[&<>"']/g,c=>({'&':'&amp;','<':'&lt;','>':'&gt;','"':'&quot;',"'":'&#039;'}[c]))}
function cmsFmtDate(v){if(!v)return '';const d=new Date(v+'T12:00:00');return isNaN(d)?v:d.toLocaleDateString('en-GB',{day:'numeric',month:'short',year:'numeric'})}
function cmsAdminManager(type,title,subtitle,fields){
  const list=cmsCollection(type);
  const rows=list.map(x=>`<article class="cms-record"><div><h4>${cmsEscape(x.title||x.name||x.school||'Untitled')}</h4><p>${cmsEscape(x.summary||x.desc||x.notes||x.address||x.role||'')}</p><div class="cms-record-meta"><span>${cmsEscape(x.status||'Live')}</span>${x.date?`<span>${cmsFmtDate(x.date)}</span>`:''}${x.category?`<span>${cmsEscape(x.category)}</span>`:''}${x.region?`<span>${cmsEscape(x.region)}</span>`:''}</div></div><div class="cms-record-actions"><button class="cms-small-btn" type="button" onclick="cmsEditRecord('${type}','${x.id}')">EDIT</button><button class="cms-small-btn danger" type="button" onclick="cmsDeleteRecord('${type}','${x.id}')">DELETE</button></div></article>`).join('');
  const formFields=fields.map(f=>cmsFieldMarkup(f)).join('');
  return adminShell(type,'Live content','Manage '+subtitle,`${cmsLiveStrip()}<div class="cms-manager-grid"><section class="cms-list-card"><div class="cms-card-head"><div><div class="kicker">Current public data</div><h3>${title}</h3></div><span class="status-chip ok">${list.length} records</span></div><div class="cms-card-body"><div class="cms-list">${rows||'<div class="cms-empty">No records yet. Add the first one using the editor.</div>'}</div></div></section><aside class="cms-editor-card"><div class="cms-card-head"><div><div class="kicker">Add / edit</div><h3 id="cms-editor-title-${type}">New ${subtitle.replace(/s$/,'')}</h3></div><button class="cms-small-btn" type="button" onclick="cmsClearForm('${type}')">CLEAR</button></div><div class="cms-card-body"><form id="cms-form-${type}" class="cms-form" onsubmit="cmsSubmitForm(event,'${type}')"><input type="hidden" name="id">${formFields}<div class="cms-form-actions"><button class="btn red" type="submit">SAVE & PUBLISH</button><button class="btn ghost" type="button" onclick="cmsClearForm('${type}')">NEW ITEM</button></div></form><div class="cms-backup-box"><p>Changes are stored on this device and reflected on the website pages in this single-file build.</p></div></div></aside></div>`)
}
function cmsFieldMarkup(f){const req=f.required?' required':'';const val=f.default||'';if(f.type==='textarea')return `<label>${f.label}<textarea name="${f.name}" placeholder="${f.placeholder||''}"${req}>${val}</textarea></label>`;if(f.type==='select')return `<label>${f.label}<select name="${f.name}"${req}>${f.options.map(o=>`<option value="${o}">${o}</option>`).join('')}</select></label>`;return `<label>${f.label}<input class="field" type="${f.type||'text'}" name="${f.name}" placeholder="${f.placeholder||''}" value="${val}"${req}></label>`}
const CMS_FIELDS={
 news:[{name:'title',label:'Title',required:true},{name:'category',label:'Category',type:'select',options:['WJO News','Community','Wellbeing','Development','Newsletter','From the Founder']},{name:'status',label:'Status',type:'select',options:['Published','Draft']},{name:'date',label:'Publish date',type:'date',required:true},{name:'author',label:'Author',placeholder:'Committee / instructor name'},{name:'summary',label:'Summary',type:'textarea',required:true},{name:'body',label:'Full article',type:'textarea',placeholder:'Write the complete article here. Separate paragraphs with a blank line.',required:true}],
 events:[{name:'title',label:'Event title',required:true},{name:'category',label:'Category',placeholder:'Seminar, grading, social event'},{name:'status',label:'Status',type:'select',options:['Published','Draft']},{name:'date',label:'Date',type:'date',required:true},{name:'venue',label:'Venue',required:true},{name:'location',label:'Location / address',required:true},{name:'desc',label:'Event details',type:'textarea',required:true}],
 gradings:[{name:'title',label:'Grading title',required:true},{name:'region',label:'Region',required:true},{name:'status',label:'Status',type:'select',options:['Open','Draft','Closed']},{name:'date',label:'Date',type:'date',required:true},{name:'venue',label:'Venue',required:true},{name:'notes',label:'Notes',type:'textarea'}],
 schools:[{name:'name',label:'School / venue name',required:true},{name:'town',label:'Town',required:true},{name:'region',label:'Region / county',required:true},{name:'postcode',label:'Postcode',required:true},{name:'address',label:'Full address',required:true},{name:'daysText',label:'Training days',placeholder:'Monday, Thursday'},{name:'programmesText',label:'Programmes',placeholder:"Super J's, Confident Kidz, Adults"},{name:'status',label:'Status',type:'select',options:['Live','Draft','Pending review']}],
 instructors:[{name:'name',label:'Instructor name',required:true},{name:'role',label:'Role / grade',required:true},{name:'school',label:'Schools / locations',required:true},{name:'status',label:'Status',type:'select',options:['Live','Draft','Private']},{name:'summary',label:'Profile summary',type:'textarea',required:true}],
 committee:[{name:'name',label:'Member name',required:true},{name:'role',label:'Committee role',required:true},{name:'visibility',label:'Visibility',type:'select',options:['Public','Members only']},{name:'status',label:'Status',type:'select',options:['Live','Draft']},{name:'summary',label:'Profile summary',type:'textarea',required:true}]
};
function cmsSubmitForm(e,type){e.preventDefault();const f=e.currentTarget;const fd=new FormData(f);const obj=Object.fromEntries(fd.entries());if(type==='schools'){obj.days=(obj.daysText||'').split(',').map(x=>x.trim()).filter(Boolean);obj.programmes=(obj.programmesText||'').split(',').map(x=>x.trim()).filter(Boolean);obj.sessions=obj.sessions||[];delete obj.daysText;delete obj.programmesText}obj.id=obj.id||cmsId(type,obj.title||obj.name||obj.school);cmsUpsert(type,obj);cmsClearForm(type);render();setTimeout(()=>document.getElementById('cms-form-'+type)?.scrollIntoView({block:'nearest'}),60)}
window.cmsSubmitForm=cmsSubmitForm;
function cmsEditRecord(type,id){const x=cmsRecord(type,id),f=document.getElementById('cms-form-'+type);if(!x||!f)return;Object.keys(x).forEach(k=>{let el=f.elements[k];if(el)el.value=Array.isArray(x[k])?x[k].join(', '):x[k]??''});if(type==='schools'){f.elements.daysText.value=(x.days||[]).join(', ');f.elements.programmesText.value=(x.programmes||[]).join(', ')}document.getElementById('cms-editor-title-'+type).textContent='Editing '+(x.title||x.name||x.school||'item');f.scrollIntoView({behavior:'smooth',block:'start'})}
window.cmsEditRecord=cmsEditRecord;
function cmsDeleteRecord(type,id){const x=cmsRecord(type,id);if(!x)return;if(confirm(`Delete "${x.title||x.name||x.school||'this item'}" from the local local content?`)){cmsRemove(type,id);render()}}
window.cmsDeleteRecord=cmsDeleteRecord;
function cmsClearForm(type){const f=document.getElementById('cms-form-'+type);if(!f)return;f.reset();f.elements.id.value='';document.getElementById('cms-editor-title-'+type).textContent='New '+type.replace(/s$/,'')}
window.cmsClearForm=cmsClearForm;

// Functional admin routes.
routes['admin-dashboard']=()=>{const d=cmsData();const k=[['News',d.news.length,'admin-news'],['Events',d.events.length,'admin-events'],['Gradings',d.gradings.length,'admin-gradings'],['Schools',d.schools.length,'admin-schools'],['Instructors',d.instructors.length,'admin-instructors'],['Committee',d.committee.length,'admin-committee']];return adminShell('dashboard','Overview','Live local CMS dashboard',`${cmsLiveStrip()}<div class="cms-admin-kpis">${k.map(([n,c,r])=>`<div class="cms-admin-kpi"><small>${n}</small><b>${c}</b><a href="#${r}">Manage →</a></div>`).join('')}</div><section class="admin-panel" style="margin-top:18px"><div class="admin-panel-head"><div><div class="kicker">Content management</div><h3>These screens now change the public website.</h3><p>Add, edit or delete content in the admin screens. The public News, Events, Find a School, Instructors and Committee pages read from the same local local content.</p></div><span class="status-chip ok">LOCAL DATA ACTIVE</span></div><div class="admin-shortcuts"><a class="admin-shortcut" href="#admin-news"><b>Add news</b><span>Publish a new story and see it appear on the public News page.</span></a><a class="admin-shortcut" href="#admin-events"><b>Add event</b><span>Create an event and see it appear in the public event calendar.</span></a><a class="admin-shortcut" href="#admin-schools"><b>Add school</b><span>Add a venue and see it appear in the School Finder.</span></a><a class="admin-shortcut" href="#admin-instructors"><b>Add instructor</b><span>Create a profile and see it added to the instructor directory.</span></a></div></section>`)};
routes['admin-news']=()=>cmsAdminManager('news','News & articles','news item',CMS_FIELDS.news);
routes['admin-events']=()=>cmsAdminManager('events','Events','event',CMS_FIELDS.events);
routes['admin-gradings']=()=>cmsAdminManager('gradings','Gradings','grading',CMS_FIELDS.gradings);
routes['admin-schools']=()=>cmsAdminManager('schools','School locations','school',CMS_FIELDS.schools);
routes['admin-instructors']=()=>cmsAdminManager('instructors','Instructor profiles','instructor',CMS_FIELDS.instructors);
routes['admin-committee']=()=>cmsAdminManager('committee','Committee profiles','committee member',CMS_FIELDS.committee);

// Add Events to admin nav and hub without changing the rest of the visual system.
const _cmsAdminShell=adminShell;
adminShell=function(active,title,subtitle,content){if(!isAdminLoggedIn())return routes.admin();return shell(`<main>${pageHero('FRONT-END <em>ADMIN.</em>','Committee tools','A front-end content area for authorised WJO users to manage website content.')}<section class="page-section"><div class="wrap admin-layout"><aside class="admin-sidebar"><div class="admin-user-pill"><div><b>Committee user</b><span>${ADMIN_DEMO_USER}</span></div><button class="btn ghost" style="min-height:40px;padding:0 12px" onclick="adminLogout()">LOG OUT</button></div><div class="kicker">Management areas</div><nav class="admin-nav"><a class="${active==='hub'?'active':''}" href="#admin-hub">Committee hub<small>Overview and publishing tasks</small></a><a class="${active==='dashboard'?'active':''}" href="#admin-dashboard">Dashboard<small>Live local content totals</small></a><a class="${active==='news'?'active':''}" href="#admin-news">News<small>Add, edit and publish stories</small></a><a class="${active==='events'?'active':''}" href="#admin-events">Events<small>Public diary and calendar entries</small></a><a class="${active==='gradings'?'active':''}" href="#admin-gradings">Gradings<small>Dates, venues and grading details</small></a><a class="${active==='schools'?'active':''}" href="#admin-schools">School Locations<small>Venue details and programmes</small></a><a class="${active==='instructors'?'active':''}" href="#admin-instructors">Instructors<small>Profiles, roles and biographies</small></a><a class="${active==='committee'?'active':''}" href="#admin-committee">Committee<small>Public leadership profiles</small></a><a class="${active==='media'?'active':''}" href="#admin-media">Media Library<small>Media library</small></a><a class="${active==='calendar'?'active':''}" href="#admin-calendar">Calendar Editor<small>Calendar planning</small></a></nav><p class="admin-mini-note">This single-file build uses locally stored content records.</p></aside><div class="admin-main"><div class="admin-frame"><div class="admin-wpbar"><div class="admin-wpbar-left"><span class="admin-wp-pill red">WJO Front-end CMS</span><span class="admin-wp-pill">Local content store</span></div><div class="admin-wpbar-right"><span class="admin-wp-pill">Saved ${new Date(cmsData().updatedAt).toLocaleTimeString('en-GB',{hour:'2-digit',minute:'2-digit'})}</span></div></div><div class="admin-topbar"><div><div class="kicker">${title}</div><h2>${subtitle}</h2><p>Changes made here are stored locally and immediately reflected on the website pages.</p></div><div class="admin-actions-row"><a class="btn ghost" href="#home">VIEW WEBSITE</a><a class="btn red" href="#admin-dashboard">DASHBOARD</a></div></div>${content}</div></div></div></section></main>`)};
routes['admin-hub']=()=>adminShell('hub','Committee hub','Front-end content management',`${cmsLiveStrip()}<div class="admin-module-grid"><section class="admin-module-card"><div class="kicker">Publishing</div><h3>News and events</h3><p>Create public stories and events. Saved records immediately appear on the public News and Events pages.</p><div class="admin-actions-row"><a class="btn red" href="#admin-news">MANAGE NEWS</a><a class="btn ghost" href="#admin-events">MANAGE EVENTS</a></div></section><section class="admin-module-card"><div class="kicker">Organisation data</div><h3>Schools, instructors and committee</h3><p>Maintain the public directories using the same local records displayed by the website.</p><div class="admin-actions-row"><a class="btn red" href="#admin-schools">SCHOOLS</a><a class="btn ghost" href="#admin-instructors">INSTRUCTORS</a></div></section><section class="admin-module-card"><div class="kicker">Gradings</div><h3>Manage grading records</h3><p>Add dates, venues, regions and notes. Open grading records also appear in the public Events & Gradings diary.</p><div class="admin-actions-row"><a class="btn red" href="#admin-gradings">GRADINGS</a></div></section><section class="admin-module-card"><div class="kicker">Local backups</div><h3>Export and import JSON</h3><p>The whole local contentbase can be saved to a local JSON file and restored later.</p>${cmsBackupControls()}</section></div>`);

// Dynamic public news.
function cmsNewsCard(x){const image=x.image||'assets/news-newsletter.jpg';const cls=x.seed?'':' cms-public-added';return `<article class="news-card${cls}" style="--newsbg:url('${image}');position:relative"><div class="tag">${cmsEscape(x.category||'WJO News')}</div><h3>${cmsEscape(x.title)}</h3><p style="color:#d3d7de">${cmsEscape(x.summary||'')}</p><div class="cms-record-meta"><span>${cmsFmtDate(x.date)}</span><span>${cmsEscape(x.author||'WJO')}</span></div></article>`}
routes.news=()=>{const items=cmsCollection('news').filter(x=>String(x.status).toLowerCase()==='published').sort((a,b)=>String(b.date).localeCompare(String(a.date)));return shell(`<main>${pageHero('STORIES FROM <em>THE WJO.</em>','News & insights','Organisation news, training insight, student stories and community activity.')}<section class="page-section"><div class="wrap"><div class="cms-public-note"></div><div class="news-grid">${items.map(cmsNewsCard).join('')}</div></div></section></main>`)};

// Dynamic public events & gradings.
function cmsCombinedEvents(){const ev=cmsCollection('events').filter(x=>String(x.status).toLowerCase()==='published').map(x=>({...x,_type:'events'}));const gr=cmsCollection('gradings').filter(x=>!['draft','closed'].includes(String(x.status).toLowerCase())).map(x=>({id:x.id,title:x.title,category:'Grading • '+(x.region||'WJO'),status:'Published',date:x.date,venue:x.venue,location:x.region||'',desc:x.notes||'',_type:'gradings',seed:x.seed}));return [...ev,...gr].sort((a,b)=>String(a.date).localeCompare(String(b.date)))}
function cmsShowEvent(type,id){const x=cmsRecord(type,id);if(!x)return;alert(`${x.title}\n\n${cmsFmtDate(x.date)}\n${x.venue||''}\n${x.location||x.region||''}\n\n${x.desc||x.notes||''}`)}
window.cmsShowEvent=cmsShowEvent;
function cmsEventRow(x){const cls=x.seed?'':' cms-public-added';return `<article class="event-row-v28${cls}" style="position:relative"><div class="event-date-v28"><div class="day">${String(new Date(x.date+'T12:00:00').getDate()).padStart(2,'0')}</div><div><div class="month">${new Date(x.date+'T12:00:00').toLocaleString('en-GB',{month:'short'}).toUpperCase()}</div><div class="weekday">${new Date(x.date+'T12:00:00').toLocaleString('en-GB',{weekday:'short'})}</div></div></div><div class="event-body-v28"><div class="kicker">${cmsEscape(x.category||'WJO Event')}</div><h3>${cmsEscape(x.title)}</h3><p>${cmsEscape(x.desc||'')}</p><span class="venue">${cmsEscape(x.venue||'')} ${x.location?'• '+cmsEscape(x.location):''}</span></div><button class="btn ghost event-detail-button" type="button" onclick="cmsShowEvent('${x._type}','${x.id}')">VIEW DETAILS</button></article>`}
function cmsCalendarMonth(year,month,items){const first=new Date(year,month,1),days=new Date(year,month+1,0).getDate(),start=(first.getDay()+6)%7;let cells='';for(let i=0;i<start;i++)cells+='<div class="event-day-cell empty"></div>';for(let day=1;day<=days;day++){const date=`${year}-${String(month+1).padStart(2,'0')}-${String(day).padStart(2,'0')}`;const de=items.filter(e=>e.date===date);cells+=`<div class="event-day-cell ${de.length?'has-event':''}"><div class="event-day-number">${day}</div>${de.map(e=>`<button class="month-event-link" type="button" onclick="cmsShowEvent('${e._type}','${e.id}')">${cmsEscape(e.title)}<small>${cmsEscape(e.venue||'')}</small></button>`).join('')}</div>`}return `<section class="event-month"><div class="event-month-head"><div><div class="kicker">WJO Calendar</div><h2>${first.toLocaleString('en-GB',{month:'long',year:'numeric'})}</h2></div><span>${items.filter(e=>{const d=new Date(e.date+'T12:00:00');return d.getFullYear()===year&&d.getMonth()===month}).length} events</span></div><div class="event-calendar-scroll"><div class="event-calendar">${['Mon','Tue','Wed','Thu','Fri','Sat','Sun'].map(x=>`<div class="event-weekday">${x}</div>`).join('')}${cells}</div></div></section>`}
routes.events=()=>{const items=cmsCombinedEvents();const months=[...new Set(items.map(e=>e.date.slice(0,7)))].slice(0,8);return shell(`<main>${pageHero('WHAT’S COMING UP <em>AT WJO.</em>','Events & gradings','Current WJO events and grading dates.')}<section class="page-section"><div class="wrap"><div class="cms-public-note"></div><div class="event-view-toolbar"><div class="event-view-switch"><button class="active" type="button" data-view="list" onclick="setEventView('list')">LIST</button><button type="button" data-view="month" onclick="setEventView('month')">MONTH</button></div></div><div id="events-list-pane" class="event-view-pane"><div class="event-list-v28">${items.map(cmsEventRow).join('')}</div></div><div id="events-month-pane" class="event-view-pane" hidden><div class="event-months">${months.map(m=>{const [y,mo]=m.split('-').map(Number);return cmsCalendarMonth(y,mo-1,items)}).join('')}</div></div></div></section></main>`)};

// Dynamic school finder.
function cmsSchoolCard(x){return `<article class="cms-school-card ${x.seed?'':'cms-public-added'}" style="position:relative"><div class="kicker">${cmsEscape(x.region||'WJO')}</div><h3>${cmsEscape(x.name)}</h3><p>${cmsEscape(x.address||'')}<br><b>${cmsEscape(x.town||'')}</b> ${cmsEscape(x.postcode||'')}</p><div class="cms-school-tags">${(x.programmes||[]).map(p=>`<span>${cmsEscape(p)}</span>`).join('')}${(x.days||[]).map(p=>`<span>${cmsEscape(p)}</span>`).join('')}</div></article>`}
function cmsFilterSchools(){const q=(document.getElementById('cms-school-q')?.value||'').toLowerCase();document.querySelectorAll('[data-cms-school-search]').forEach(el=>el.hidden=q&&!el.dataset.cmsSchoolSearch.includes(q))}
window.cmsFilterSchools=cmsFilterSchools;
routes['find-school']=()=>{const list=cmsCollection('schools').filter(x=>String(x.status).toLowerCase()==='live');return shell(`<main>${pageHero('FIND YOUR <em>WJO.</em>','School finder','Search WJO venues by town, postcode, programme or training day.')}<section class="page-section"><div class="wrap"><div class="cms-public-note"></div><div class="school-toolbar-v5"><input id="cms-school-q" class="field location-field" placeholder="Town, postcode, programme or day" oninput="cmsFilterSchools()"></div><div class="cms-school-grid" style="margin-top:18px">${list.map(x=>`<div data-cms-school-search="${cmsEscape((x.name+' '+x.town+' '+x.postcode+' '+x.region+' '+(x.days||[]).join(' ')+' '+(x.programmes||[]).join(' ')).toLowerCase())}">${cmsSchoolCard(x)}</div>`).join('')}</div></div></section></main>`)};

// Dynamic instructor directory.
function cmsPersonCard(x){const img=x.photo?`<img src="${x.photo}" alt="${cmsEscape(x.name)}" onerror="this.outerHTML='<div class=\'cms-person-placeholder\'>WJO</div>'">`:`<div class="cms-person-placeholder">WJO</div>`;return `<article class="instructor-card ${x.seed?'':'cms-public-added'}" style="position:relative"><div class="instructor-photo">${img}</div><div class="instructor-copy"><div class="kicker">${cmsEscape(x.role||'Instructor')}</div><h3>${cmsEscape(x.name)}</h3><p>${cmsEscape(x.summary||'')}</p><div class="instructor-locations"><span>${cmsEscape(x.school||'WJO')}</span></div></div></article>`}
routes.instructors=()=>{const list=cmsCollection('instructors').filter(x=>String(x.status).toLowerCase()==='live');return shell(`<main>${pageHero('MEET THE <em>INSTRUCTORS.</em>','WJO instructors','Meet the instructors and senior teachers supporting students across the WJO network.')}<section class="page-section"><div class="wrap"><div class="cms-public-note"></div><div class="instructor-grid">${list.map(cmsPersonCard).join('')}</div></div></section></main>`)};

// Dynamic committee directory.
function cmsCommitteeCard(x){const img=x.photo?`<img src="${x.photo}" alt="${cmsEscape(x.name)}">`:`<div class="cms-person-placeholder">WJO</div>`;return `<article class="leader-card-v3 leader-card ${x.seed?'':'cms-public-added'}" style="position:relative">${img}<div class="leader-copy"><div class="kicker">${cmsEscape(x.role)}</div><h3>${cmsEscape(x.name)}</h3><p>${cmsEscape(x.summary||'')}</p></div></article>`}
routes.leadership=()=>{const list=cmsCollection('committee').filter(x=>String(x.status).toLowerCase()==='live'&&String(x.visibility).toLowerCase()==='public');return shell(`<main>${pageHero('MEET THE <em>WJO LEADERSHIP.</em>','Committee','The people responsible for leadership, safeguarding, technical development and grading standards across the organisation.')}<section class="page-section"><div class="wrap"><div class="cms-public-note"></div><div class="leader-grid-v3">${list.map(cmsCommitteeCard).join('')}</div></div></section></main>`)};
// ======================= END V41 FUNCTIONAL LOCAL CMS =======================


// ======================= V42 NEWS/EVENT FIX + MEDIA CRUD =======================
